2. 美國與伊朗可能很快就重新開放荷姆茲海峽達成協議，國際油價應聲重挫，熱錢進一步回流亞洲，台北股匯 5 日同步走揚，新台幣兌美元一度強升 1.7 角，尾盤升幅收斂，收在 32.315 元，升值 1.32 角，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 28.395 億美元。

4. 南亞科 (2408-TW) 5 日召開董事會，通過重要決議，宣布提高今年資本支出，由原訂之新台幣 520 億元提高至不超過新台幣 697 億元為上限，增加預算主要用於支付 5A 新廠產能建置所需部分設備之預付款。
5. 股王信驊 (5274-TW) 5 日公告第二季財報，單季稅後純益 18.41 億元，季增 30.2%，年增 188.4%，創單季歷史新高紀錄，每股純益 40.87 元，累計上半年稅後純益 32.55 億元，年成長 114.71%，每股大賺 78.28 元；受惠 AI 伺服器進入高速成長建置期，信驊今年上半年就賺贏去年前三季。
6. 士電 (1503-TW) 總經理郭約瑟 5 日指出，目前全球 AIDC 產業鏈的需求非常強勁，科技業也積極擴廠，認為 5 年內需求不墜。另外，由於需求強勁，變壓器出現缺貨潮，郭約瑟則指出，士電因預先採購，交期不受影響。

paras_en: On August 6, pre‑market Taiwan stock news:

1. The Taiwan Stock Exchange closed at 44,611.6 points on the 5th, up 1,250.94 points or 2.88%. Trading volume swelled to NT$1.14 trillion, returning to the trillion‑dollar level, and the index broke through both its monthly and quarterly moving averages. The three major institutional investors net‑bought a total of NT$100.406 billion, with foreign investors leading the charge by net‑buying NT$90.308 billion – the third‑largest net purchase on record. They also bought more than 117,000 lots of the 00631L Yuanta Taiwan 50 Leveraged 2 ETF. The top individual stock purchases were Kai‑Fund (39,000 lots), Foxconn (36,000 lots), Wistron (35,000 lots) and Lite‑On Technology (29,000 lots).

2. The United States and Iran may soon reach an agreement to reopen the Hormuz Strait, causing international oil prices to plunge. Hot money flowed back into Asia, lifting both Taiwan’s stock market and its currency on the 5th. The New Taiwan dollar briefly appreciated by 0.17 NT$ against the US dollar, ending the session at NT$32.315, a gain of 0.132 NT$. The combined turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets amounted to US$2.8395 billion.

3. Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced on the 5th that its July revenue reached NT$946.512 billion, a historic monthly high and making it the first Taiwanese listed company poised to achieve a trillion‑NT$ month. Revenue grew 15.18% month‑over‑month and 54.19% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first seven months hit NT$5.59 trillion, also a record for the period, up 37.89% year‑over‑year.

4. Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) held a board meeting on the 5th and passed a resolution to raise its 2024 capital expenditure cap from NT$52 billion to a maximum of NT$69.7 billion. The additional budget will mainly be used to pre‑pay for equipment needed to build capacity at its new 5A fab.

5. Stock‑king Xinyuan (5274‑TW) released its Q2 earnings on the 5th, reporting a quarterly net profit of NT$1.841 billion, up 30.2% sequentially and 188.4% year‑over‑year – a record high for a single quarter. Earnings per share were NT$40.87. For the first half of the year, net profit totaled NT$3.255 billion, a 114.71% annual increase, or NT$78.28 per share. Benefiting from the rapid growth phase of AI server construction, Xinyuan earned in the first half of this year as much as it did in the first three quarters of last year.

6. General Manager Guo Yueshe of Sih‑Power (1503‑TW) said on the 5th that global demand for the AIDC (Automatic Identification and Data Capture) supply chain remains very strong and that the tech sector is actively expanding capacity, believing demand will not decline over the next five years. Because of this strong demand, transformer shortages have emerged, but Guo noted that Sih‑Power’s advance procurement means delivery times are unaffected.
Post‑market Taiwan stock wrap: TSMC closed at NT$2,405, jumping 1,250 points to retake its monthly, quarterly and the 44,000‑point milestone.
Foreign investors flipped to net buying at record speed, posting the third‑largest ever net purchase of NT$90.3 billion and snapping up more than 110,000 lots of the Yuanta Taiwan 50 Leveraged 2 ETF.
The New Taiwan dollar surged 0.132 NT$ to close at NT$32.315 as hot money returned to stocks and FX.
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.’s July revenue hit NT$19.207 billion, a new high, up 129% year‑over‑year.
Largan Precision’s July revenue reached NT$4.877 billion, up 31.38% month‑over‑month, with momentum expected to continue as the company ramps up shipments this month.
Eighty‑plus Taiwan‑listed ETFs announced dividend payouts; three of them posted annualized yields exceeding 18%.
Twenty‑two overseas ETFs hit fresh highs; 00757 surged 12% in the past week, the strongest performer.
Sih‑Power’s General Manager Guo Yueshe sees global AIDC demand remaining robust, with no shortage concerns for the next five years.
Xinyuan’s Q2 profit surge set new highs for four of its stock categories, and July revenue also reached a new record.
Nanya Technology raised its 2024 capital‑expenditure ceiling to NT$69.7 billion, with a four‑year cap of NT$346.6 billion.
Foxconn’s July revenue of NT$946.5 billion, up 15% month‑over‑month, is on track to become the strongest single‑month revenue ever, approaching the trillion‑NT$ mark.

1) Market outlook
Wednesday saw Hong Kong stocks rise, higher turnover and the short‑selling ratio fell to a low 13.1%. August is the peak season for quarterly earnings releases, a key driver of individual stock performance.

Xiaomi (1810) and NetEase (9999) fell over 1%, the biggest decliners among the constituents. Minimax (100) and Lenovo (992) surged over 10% and 5%, the top gainers. China Construction Bank (939), Bank of China (3988) and China Merchants Bank (3968) each fell over 1%. Budweiser Asia Pacific (1876) and China Resources Beer (291) each fell over 1%.

items.title: SpaceX市值一夕蒸發2250億美元 AI燒錢疑慮蓋過亮眼財報
items.title_en: SpaceX Loses $225 Billion in Market Value Overnight as AI Spending Concerns Overshadow Strong Earnings
paras: SpaceX (SPCX-US) 週三 (5 日) 股價狂瀉逾 13% 至每股 108.27 美元，市值一夕蒸發 2,250 億美元，主因市場對公司大舉投入人工智慧 (AI) 基礎建設的資本支出感到憂心，儘管第二季營收優於市場預期、虧損也持續收斂，但龐大的現金消耗仍成為投資人關注焦點。
這是 SpaceX 自 6 月完成歷史性 IPO 後首度公布財報。執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 在法說會上同步描繪未來藍圖，將公司 2030 年營收目標上調至 1 兆美元，較原先預期提前一年達成，並宣布計畫最快於明年開始部署太空資料中心，進一步強化 AI 基礎設施布局。
不過，相較於營運成長，市場更聚焦於現金流表現。SpaceX 今年前兩季自由現金流均呈現大幅流出，其中第二季資本支出高達 183.6 億美元，較去年同期增加約 28 億美元。
公司表示，第二季資本支出中約有 158 億美元投入 AI 業務，顯示 AI 已成為目前最重要的投資方向。IPO 前，SpaceX 便將自己定位為兼具太空、衛星通訊與 AI 基礎建設的科技公司，希望藉此吸引更多投資人。
從營運表現來看，AI 業務仍是成長最快的部門。第二季營收年增 247% 至 26 億美元，主要受惠於新增雲端服務合約，單季帶來約 16 億美元 AI 基礎設施收入，同時整體運算容量也提升至 1.4GW。
然而，目前最主要的獲利來源仍是以 Starlink 為核心的衛星通訊業務。受惠於 Starlink 用戶數較去年同期倍增，第二季該部門營收年增 66% 至 43 億美元，持續穩居公司最大收入來源，客戶涵蓋一般消費者、企業、政府，以及航空、郵輪等商業市場。
財報顯示，SpaceX 第二季營收達 78.1 億美元，高於市場預估的 68.1 億美元；調整後每股虧損為 0.09 美元，也較去年同期的每股虧損 0.34 美元明顯改善。
不過，研究機構 Vital Knowledge 指出，雖然營收與 EBITDA 表現亮眼，但自由現金流惡化反映公司正以前所未見的速度投入 AI 建設，短期內將持續對財務造成壓力，這也是市場對財報反應偏向保守的主因。
SpaceX 由馬斯克於 2002 年創立，目前業務涵蓋三大領域，包括太空發射 (Space)、衛星通訊 (Connectivity) 與人工智慧 (AI)。其中，Starlink 衛星網路仍是公司規模最大的業務，IPO 後則積極擴大 AI 基礎設施布局，希望打造新的成長引擎。
SpaceX IPO 發行價為每股 135 美元，上市後股價一度衝破 200 美元，但近期已明顯回落，較高點蒸發逾 1 兆美元市值，顯示市場對公司長期成長前景仍抱持期待，但對短期高額 AI 投資與現金流壓力保持審慎態度。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) saw its stock price plummet by over 13% to $108.27 per share on Wednesday, wiping out $225 billion in market value, as investors expressed concerns over the company's massive capital expenditures on artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, despite beating market expectations for revenue and narrowing losses in the second quarter.

This was SpaceX's first earnings report since its historic IPO in June. CEO Elon Musk outlined the company's future plans during the earnings call, raising the 2030 revenue target to $1 trillion, a year ahead of schedule, and announcing plans to start deploying space data centers as early as next year to further strengthen its AI infrastructure.

However, the market was more focused on the company's cash flow performance. SpaceX reported significant outflows in free cash flow for the first two quarters of the year, with capital expenditures reaching $18.36 billion in the second quarter, a $2.8 billion increase from the same period last year.

The company stated that approximately $15.8 billion of the second-quarter capital expenditures were invested in AI businesses, indicating that AI has become the most important investment direction. Prior to its IPO, SpaceX positioned itself as a technology company with a focus on space, satellite communications, and AI infrastructure, aiming to attract more investors.

In terms of operating performance, the AI business remains the fastest-growing segment. Second-quarter revenue increased by 247% year-over-year to $2.6 billion, primarily driven by new cloud service contracts, which generated approximately $1.6 billion in AI infrastructure revenue for the quarter, with total computing capacity also increasing to 1.4GW.

However, the primary source of profit remains the satellite communications business, centered around Starlink. Driven by a doubling of Starlink users compared to the same period last year, second-quarter revenue for this segment increased by 66% year-over-year to $4.3 billion, continuing to be the company's largest source of revenue, with customers spanning individual consumers, enterprises, governments, and commercial markets such as aviation and cruises.

The earnings report showed that SpaceX's second-quarter revenue reached $7.81 billion, exceeding market estimates of $6.81 billion, with adjusted loss per share of $0.09, a significant improvement from the loss per share of $0.34 in the same period last year.

However, research firm Vital Knowledge noted that while revenue and EBITDA performance were strong, the deterioration in free cash flow reflects the company's unprecedented investment in AI construction, which will continue to put pressure on its finances in the short term, making this the primary reason for the market's conservative reaction to the earnings report.

Founded by Musk in 2002, SpaceX currently operates in three main areas: space launch (Space), satellite communications (Connectivity), and artificial intelligence (AI). Among these, the Starlink satellite network remains the company's largest business, while it has been actively expanding its AI infrastructure layout since its IPO, aiming to create a new growth engine.

SpaceX's IPO issue price was $135 per share, and its stock price once surged above $200 after listing, but has since fallen back, with over $1 trillion in market value evaporating from its peak, indicating that the market still expects long-term growth prospects but remains cautious about the company's short-term high AI investments and cash flow pressure.

items.title: 〈財報〉格芯搭上AI順風車！矽光子需求帶旺第二季業績
items.title_en: <Earnings> GlobalFoundries Rides AI Wave! Silicon Photonics Boost Q2 Results
paras: 晶圓代工業者格芯 (格羅方德 / GlobalFoundries)(GFS-US) 周三 (5 日) 公布 2026 會計年度第二季 (截至 6 月 30 日) 財報，受惠人工智慧 (AI) 資料中心帶動矽光子晶片需求，營收與調整後每股盈餘均優於華爾街預期。
格芯第二季營收為 17.9 億美元，高於 LSEG 統計分析師平均預估的 17.7 億美元；調整後稀釋每股盈餘為 0.46 美元，同樣優於市場預期的 0.44 美元。
格芯主要生產特殊應用晶片，產品廣泛用於通訊、資料中心、汽車、工業及消費性電子設備。隨著科技公司擴大 AI 基礎設施投資，市場對格芯矽光子晶片的需求逐步升溫。
矽光子技術以光訊號取代傳統電訊號傳輸資料，能提高 AI 資料中心內部的資料傳輸速度並降低能源消耗。在 AI 模型規模擴大、運算系統需要連接更多處理器之際，高速且節能的資料傳輸技術日益重要，也成為格芯新的成長動能。
展望第三季，格芯預估營收為 18.9 億美元，上下浮動 2,500 萬美元，大致符合分析師預估的 18.8 億美元。以公司預測區間計算，第三季營收可能落在 18.65 億至 19.15 億美元之間。
不過，格芯第二季調整後自由現金流為負 300 萬美元，明顯低於去年同期的正 2.77 億美元，顯示公司儘管營收與獲利優於預期，現金流表現仍面臨壓力。
此外，格芯今年 3 月對以色列同業 Tower Semiconductor 提起訴訟，指控對方侵犯 11 項半導體製造專利，涉及智慧型手機及其他電子產品所使用的晶片。這起專利爭議仍在進行中。
截稿前，格芯 (GFS-US) 周三盤中股價下跌 4.17%，每股暫報 49.85 美元。
paras_en: Wafer foundry GlobalFoundries (GFS-US) released its fiscal 2026 second‑quarter results (ended June 30) on Wednesday, May 5. Benefiting from AI data‑center driven demand for silicon‑photonic chips, both revenue and adjusted earnings per share beat Wall Street expectations.
Q2 revenue was $1.79 billion, above the LSEG analysts’ average forecast of $1.77 billion. Adjusted diluted EPS came in at $0.46, also topping the market’s $0.44 consensus estimate.

GlobalFoundries primarily manufactures specialty‑application chips used broadly in communications, data centers, automotive, industrial and consumer electronics. As tech companies expand AI infrastructure investments, demand for GlobalFoundries’ silicon‑photonic chips is warming up.

Silicon‑photonic technology replaces traditional electrical signals with light to transmit data, increasing data‑transfer speed inside AI data centers while cutting energy consumption. With AI models growing larger and compute systems needing to link more processors, high‑speed, energy‑efficient data transfer is becoming increasingly important and serves as a new growth driver for GlobalFoundries.

Looking ahead to Q3, GlobalFoundries projects revenue of $1.89 billion, give or take $25 million, roughly in line with analysts’ estimate of $1.88 billion. Based on the company’s guidance range, Q3 revenue could fall between $1.865 billion and $1.915 billion.

However, adjusted free cash flow in Q2 was a negative $3 million, sharply down from a positive $277 million in the same quarter last year, indicating that despite better‑than‑expected revenue and profit, cash‑flow pressure remains.

In addition, GlobalFoundries filed a lawsuit in March against Israeli peer Tower Semiconductor, alleging infringement of 11 semiconductor‑manufacturing patents covering chips used in smartphones and other electronic products. The patent dispute is ongoing.
Before the market close, GlobalFoundries (GFS-US) shares fell 4.17% in mid‑day trading, quoted at $49.85 per share.

items.title: 27年老將帶隊出走！Google痛失四名AI大將 盤中股價一度跌逾5%
items.title_en: 27-Year Veteran Leads Exit! Google Loses Four AI Leaders, Stock Drops Over 5% Intraday
paras: Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下 Google 周三 (5 日) 宣布大幅改組人工智慧 (AI) 領導團隊。Google DeepMind 共同創辦人兼執行長哈薩比斯 (Demis Hassabis) 將卸下日常營運職務，改任 DeepMind 董事長及 Alphabet 首席科學家；在 Google 任職 27 年的首席科學家狄恩 (Jeff Dean) 則將離職創業。消息公布後，Alphabet 股價盤中一度下跌逾 5%。
截稿前，Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 周三盤中股價下跌 3.50%，每股暫報 364.43 美元。
Google DeepMind 技術長 Koray Kavukcuoglu 將升任資深副總裁，接手哈薩比斯多數職責，全面負責 Google 的 AI 模型開發，並直接向 Alphabet 執行長皮查伊 (Sundar Pichai) 報告。他也將領導下一代主要 AI 模型 Gemini 4 的研發。
哈薩比斯表示，現在是交出 DeepMind 日常營運工作的適當時機，讓他能把時間與心力放在更宏觀的 AI 發展方向。未來他將與皮查伊合作，處理 AI 相關的策略及全球性議題。
狄恩則將與 Google 資深研究員 Sanjay Ghemawat、Oriol Vinyals 及 Quoc Le 共同創立 AI 新創公司 Discovery Loop，由狄恩擔任執行長。新公司將採公共利益公司形式，運用 AI 自動化複雜且涉及多個步驟的科學與工程工作，加速機器學習、硬體設計、藥物研發及潔淨能源等領域的發現。
Discovery Loop 初期將聚焦自動化機器學習研究與工程流程。狄恩表示，許多科學研究包含提出假設、設計與執行實驗，再評估結果等反覆步驟，其中不少流程可以完全電腦化，這也成為公司名稱的由來。

這批離職成員均是 Google 重要 AI 技術功臣。狄恩曾共同創立 Google Brain，並主導張量處理器 (TPU) 開發；Vinyals 是蛋白質結構預測系統 AlphaFold 的重要貢獻者；Le 則參與 Google 數學推理 AI 系統研發。Google 將投資 Discovery Loop 並提供雲端及運算資源，Radical Ventures 與 Khosla Ventures 則共同領投種子輪。

這波改組正值 Google 與 OpenAI、Anthropic 競逐前沿 AI 模型的關鍵時刻。Google 近期接連流失頂尖人才，Noam Shazeer 已轉投 OpenAI，AlphaFold 諾貝爾獎得主 John Jumper 也加入 Anthropic。Google 最新版 Gemini 3.5 Pro 遲遲尚未推出，部分 Meta 模型在特定評測中的表現也已超越 Gemini，令投資人逐漸失去耐心。
與此同時，Google 大幅提高 AI 基礎設施支出，預估全年資本支出最高達 2,050 億美元，上一季自由現金流更首度轉為負值。在 AI 競爭升溫、支出急速擴張之際，核心主管與研究人才相繼異動，使市場更加擔憂 Google 能否維持 AI 領先地位。
paras_en: Alphabet (GOOGL-US) subsidiary Google announced on Wednesday (the 5th) a major reshuffle of its artificial intelligence (AI) leadership team. DeepMind co‑founder and CEO Demis Hassabis will step down from day‑to‑day operations to become DeepMind chairman and Alphabet chief scientist; Jeff Dean, who has been Alphabet’s chief scientist for 27 years, will leave to start his own venture. After the news broke, Alphabet’s share price fell more than 5% at one point during trading.
By the time of writing, Alphabet (GOOGL-US) was down 3.50% in mid‑day trading, with the stock quoted at $364.43 per share.

DeepMind’s chief technology officer Koray Kavukcuoglu will be promoted to senior vice president, taking over most of Hassabis’s duties and assuming full responsibility for Google’s AI model development, reporting directly to Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai. He will also lead the development of the next‑generation flagship AI model Gemini 4.

Hassabis said the timing is right for him to hand over DeepMind’s daily operations so he can focus his time and energy on broader AI development directions. Going forward he will work with Pichai on AI strategy and global issues.

Dean will co‑found an AI startup called Discovery Loop with senior Google researchers Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals and Quoc Le, serving as its CEO. The new company will be organized as a public‑interest corporation and will use AI to automate complex, multi‑step scientific and engineering work, accelerating discoveries in machine learning, hardware design, drug development and clean energy.

Discovery Loop will initially focus on automating machine‑learning research and engineering workflows. Dean explained that many scientific projects involve repeated cycles of hypothesis generation, experiment design and execution, and result evaluation, many of which can be fully computerised – the inspiration for the company’s name.

These departing members are key AI contributors at Google. Dean co‑founded Google Brain and led the development of Tensor Processing Units (TPUs); Vinyals was a major contributor to the protein‑structure prediction system AlphaFold; Le helped develop Google’s mathematical reasoning AI system. Google will invest in Discovery Loop and provide cloud and compute resources, while Radical Ventures and Khosla Ventures will co‑lead the seed round.

The reshuffle comes as Google battles OpenAI and Anthropic for cutting‑edge AI models. Google has recently lost top talent, with Noam Shazeer moving to OpenAI and AlphaFold Nobel laureate John Jumper joining Anthropic. Google’s latest Gemini 3.5 Pro has yet to launch, and some Meta models have already outperformed Gemini in specific benchmarks, eroding investor patience.

At the same time, Google has sharply increased AI infrastructure spending, forecasting annual capital expenditures up to $205 billion, and its free cash flow turned negative for the first time last quarter. Amid escalating AI competition and rapidly expanding spend, the turnover of senior executives and researchers is heightening market concerns about Google’s ability to maintain its AI leadership.

items.title: 表面救日元、背後保美債！貝森特盯上Fed疫情時代工具
items.title_en: Surface Rescue of the Yen, Backing US Treasuries! Bessonnet Targets Fed’s Pandemic-Era Tool
paras: 美國財長貝森特正敦促聯準會 (Fed) 擴大一項原本為 2020 年美元荒設立的緊急融資工具，讓日本能以持有的美國公債作為擔保借入更多美元，用於買進日元、阻止匯率持續下跌，同時避免東京為籌措干預資金而大舉拋售美債。
日本政府周一表示，計畫動用 Fed 的「外國及國際貨幣當局附買回機制」(FIMA Repo Facility)，為未來的匯市干預籌集美元。這項安排原本不是為支撐外國貨幣設計，如今卻可能成為日本捍衛日元的重要資金來源，也引發 Fed 是否應協助川普政府執行匯率與外交政策的爭議。

抵押美債換美元 日本無須拋售 1.1 兆美元部位

FIMA 機制是在新冠疫情初期設立。當時美元融資市場陷入緊張，部分未與 Fed 建立貨幣交換管道的外國央行，可能被迫出售美國公債換取美元，進一步加劇美債市場的流動性危機。Fed 因此允許外國貨幣當局以美債作為擔保，透過附買回交易取得美元。
在新的運用方式下，日本可將美債暫時交給 Fed 換取美元，再於外匯市場賣出美元、買進日元，達到支撐匯率的目的，而不必直接處分美債。截至 5 月底，日本持有約 1.1 兆美元美國公債，真正限制其融資能力的並非抵押品不足，而是 FIMA 機制對單一交易對手設定的 600 億美元借款上限。
貝森特周日在社群平台 X 公開表示，Fed 可協助提高這項額度，並鼓勵央行未來數月擴大上限。若額度獲得調高，東京便可迅速把更多美債轉化為可供干預的美元資金，也能向市場傳達日本阻貶工具並不像表面上那樣有限，增加投機客放空日元的成本。
日本財務大臣片山皋月周一證實，東京準備使用 FIMA 機制支應未來干預。此前，美日上周五採取聯合行動，由美國與日本同步買進日元，是 1998 年以來首見。美國總統川普將這項行動形容為兩國友誼的象徵，而日元近期一度跌至 40 年低點。

華府要救的不只日元 更要避免日本拋售美債

華府支持日本穩定日元，背後也牽涉美債市場。各國捍衛本幣時，通常會出售外匯存底並買回本國貨幣，而日本的外匯存底主要由美國公債構成。若東京依循傳統方式長期干預，便可能被迫大量拋售美債。
目前美國 30 年期公債殖利率已升至 2007 年以來最高，市場承接能力備受關注。讓日本透過 FIMA 機制抵押美債取得美元，可以避免干預行動進一步推高美債殖利率，這也是華府希望促成這項安排的重要原因。
貝森特其實也能繞過 Fed，由美國財政部發行國庫券籌集美元，再透過規模約 2,000 億美元的外匯穩定基金 (Exchange Stabilization Fund) 提供資金。不過，這種方式的規模更加透明、資源也明顯有限，威嚇市場的效果不如 Fed 融資工具。
Monetary Policy Analytics 經濟學家 Derek Tang 指出，若貝森特無法取得 Fed 支持，其口頭威嚇市場的可信度就會降低。公開要求擴大 FIMA 額度，一方面可能只是無須付出成本的策略性喊話，讓市場相信日本握有更強火力；另一方面，也可能是在對聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 其他成員施壓。
弱勢日元同時推高日本通膨預期，促使投資人要求更高報酬才願意持有日本公債。日本 10 年期公債殖利率今年以來已上升 0.75 個百分點。由於日本金融機構是全球最大的跨境債權人，國內殖利率走高將降低其持有海外債券的誘因，可能吸引原本投入美債、德國公債及英國公債的資金回流日本。

Fed 要不要配合？華許獨立性迎來首次考驗

調高 FIMA 單一交易對手 600 億美元的借款上限，需要至少部分 FOMC 成員批准。Fed 通常只有在市場運作失靈或金融穩定受到威脅，並可能妨礙貨幣政策傳導時，才會擴大使用這類工具；目前的市場情況似乎尚未達到這項門檻。Fed 發言人拒絕置評。
這項要求也成為華許 5 月接掌 Fed 後，如何劃分央行與川普政府權力界線的首場考驗。Fed 的獨立性通常主要體現在利率決策，因為利率最容易受到政治壓力影響；但涉及向外國央行提供貸款等其他職能時，央行與行政部門之間的界線向來較為模糊。
華許在任命確認前提交給參議員的書面答覆中表示，Fed 在制定利率政策時擁有最高程度的獨立性，但在其他領域則不完全如此。涉及國際金融議題時，Fed 官員並不享有特殊決定權，央行應與政府及國會合作。
不過，華許上月在國會聽證會被問及類似問題時，又把 Fed 與外國央行的常設美元融資管道稱為貨幣政策的一部分。如今尚不清楚，他會把協助日本干預日元歸入央行貨幣政策，還是川普政府的外交及財政政策。貝森特與華許經常聯絡，這項決定也將檢驗新任 Fed 主席能否在配合政府與維護央行自主性之間取得平衡。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessonnet is urging the Federal Reserve (Fed) to expand an emergency financing tool originally created in 2020 to address a dollar shortage, allowing Japan to borrow more dollars against its holdings of U.S. Treasuries, use the dollars to buy yen and halt the currency’s decline, while avoiding a massive sell‑off of U.S. bonds by Tokyo to raise intervention funds.

The Japanese government said on Monday it plans to tap the Fed’s Foreign and International Monetary Authorities (FIMA) Repo Facility to raise dollars for future FX market interventions. The arrangement was not designed to support foreign currencies, but it could become a key source of funding for Japan’s defense of the yen, sparking debate over whether the Fed should help the Trump administration execute exchange‑rate and diplomatic policy.
Collateralizing U.S. Treasuries for Dollars – No Need for Japan to Sell Its $1.1 Trillion Holding

The FIMA mechanism was set up early in the COVID‑19 pandemic when the dollar funding market tightened. Some foreign central banks without a direct Fed swap line risked being forced to sell U.S. Treasuries for dollars, worsening Treasury market liquidity. The Fed therefore allowed foreign monetary authorities to use Treasuries as collateral in repo transactions to obtain dollars.

Under the new usage, Japan could temporarily hand its Treasuries to the Fed in exchange for dollars, then sell the dollars for yen in the FX market to support the exchange rate, without directly disposing of the bonds. As of the end of May, Japan holds about $1.1 trillion of U.S. Treasuries; the real constraint on its financing is not a lack of collateral but the $60 billion borrowing cap that the FIMA facility imposes on any single counterparty.

Bessonnet posted on X on Sunday that the Fed could help raise that limit and encouraged the central bank to expand the cap over the coming months. If the limit is raised, Tokyo could quickly convert more Treasuries into dollars for intervention, signalling that Japan’s anti‑depreciation tools are not as limited as they appear and raising the cost for speculators shorting the yen.

Finance Minister Shigeyuki Katayama confirmed on Monday that Tokyo is ready to use the FIMA facility for future interventions. Last Friday, the U.S. and Japan carried out a joint action buying yen in sync – the first such coordinated move since 1998. President Trump described the action as a symbol of the two countries’ friendship, as the yen had recently slipped to a 40‑year low.
Washington’s Goal Is Not Only to Save the Yen but Also to Prevent Japan from Dumping Treasuries

Washington’s support for a stable yen also ties to the Treasury market. When countries defend their own currencies, they usually sell foreign‑exchange reserves and buy back domestic money; Japan’s reserves are largely made up of U.S. Treasuries. A traditional, long‑term intervention strategy could force Tokyo to sell large amounts of Treasuries.

U.S. 30‑year Treasury yields have risen to their highest level since 2007, raising concerns about market capacity. Allowing Japan to obtain dollars by repo‑ing Treasuries through FIMA can avoid further upward pressure on Treasury yields from intervention, which is a key reason the administration backs the arrangement.

Bessonnet could also bypass the Fed by having the Treasury issue Treasury bills to raise dollars and then channel the funds through the roughly $200 billion Exchange Stabilization Fund. However, that route is more transparent, has a clearly limited resource pool, and is less effective at intimidating markets than a Fed‑backed financing tool.

Monetary‑policy analyst Derek Tang notes that if Bessonnet cannot secure Fed support, his market‑threatening rhetoric loses credibility. Publicly demanding a larger FIMA limit may be a cost‑free strategic shout‑out to make markets believe Japan has stronger firepower, or it could be an effort to pressure other members of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC).

A weak yen also lifts inflation expectations in Japan, prompting investors to demand higher yields to hold Japanese bonds. Japan’s 10‑year yield has risen 0.75 percentage points so far this year. Because Japanese financial institutions are the world’s largest cross‑border bondholders, higher domestic yields reduce the incentive to hold overseas bonds and could draw funds that were in U.S., German and U.K. Treasuries back to Japan.
Will the Fed Cooperate? Powell’s Independence Faces Its First Test

Raising the $60 billion single‑counterparty borrowing cap under FIMA would require approval from at least some FOMC members. The Fed usually expands such tools only when market functioning breaks down or financial stability is threatened in a way that could impede monetary‑policy transmission; current conditions do not appear to meet that threshold. A Fed spokesperson declined to comment.

The request also marks the first test, since Powell took over the Fed in May, of how the central bank will delineate its authority from that of the Trump administration. The Fed’s independence is most evident in rate‑setting, which is highly vulnerable to political pressure, but the line between the central bank and the executive is blurrier when it comes to lending to foreign central banks.

In a written response to senators before his confirmation, Powell said the Fed enjoys the highest degree of independence in setting interest‑rate policy, but not necessarily in other areas. On international‑finance issues, Fed officials do not have special decision‑making authority and must work with the government and Congress.

However, in a congressional hearing last month Powell referred to the Fed’s standing dollar‑funding facilities for foreign central banks as part of monetary policy. It remains unclear whether he will treat assistance to Japan’s yen‑intervention as monetary policy or as a Trump‑administration diplomatic and fiscal measure. Bessonnet’s frequent contact with Powell means the decision will test the new Fed chair’s ability to balance government cooperation with central‑bank autonomy.

items.title: 荷姆茲海峽要重開了？伊朗宣布與阿曼達成協議
items.title_en: Is the Strait of Hormuz Set to Reopen? Iran Announces Agreement with Oman
paras: 伊朗周三 (5 日) 表示，已與阿曼就荷姆茲海峽的建議航運路線達成協議，可能成為重新開放這條全球關鍵能源運輸水道的重要一步。不過，伊朗官媒隨後淡化外界期待，強調德黑蘭與馬斯開特達成協議，不代表海峽會立即恢復通航。
根據伊朗外交部在 Telegram 發布的消息，外交部發言人巴加伊 (Esmail Baghaei) 表示，伊朗與阿曼的聯合聲明正在審查，已進入最後定稿階段。雙方談判「專業且持續向前推進」，只要「特定第三方」不出手阻撓，最終協議就能敲定。
伊朗與阿曼近幾日持續討論荷姆茲海峽的管理方案。這條水道已成為美國與伊朗持續 5 個月戰事的焦點，大量原油與天然氣須經由此處出口，封鎖期間每天數百萬桶原油供應受到干擾。
巴加伊並未提及美國是否參與談判，僅表示荷姆茲海峽之所以關閉，是美國與以色列發動攻擊所致。美國總統川普周二晚間則在洛杉磯表示，有關荷姆茲海峽的協議即將達成。
不過，伊朗國營電視台周三引述知情人士指出，即使伊朗與阿曼完成協議，荷姆茲海峽也不一定立即開放，實際恢復通航仍取決於「美國行為是否改變」。這項說法顯示，雙方對協議效果與後續條件仍存在明顯落差。
隨著荷姆茲海峽可能重新開放的訊號增加，國際油價周三趨於穩定，倫敦布蘭特原油小幅走低至每桶約 79 美元。若航運恢復，因戰事中斷的數百萬桶每日原油供應可望逐步回到市場。
美伊雙方目前雖暫停交火，但如何結束這場長達 5 個月的戰爭仍缺乏共識，包括伊朗核計畫在內的多項爭議尚未解決，雙方也尚未同意展開正式談判。因此，伊朗與阿曼的航運協議能否真正促成荷姆茲海峽重啟，仍有待觀察。
截稿前，10 月交割的布蘭特原油期貨下跌 0.30%，至每桶 79.12 美元；9 月交割的西德州原油期貨下跌 0.69%，至每桶 75.25 美元。
paras_en: Iran on Wednesday (the 5th) said it has reached an agreement with Oman on a proposed shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz, which could be an important step toward reopening this globally critical energy corridor. However, Iranian state media later downplayed external expectations, stressing that the deal between Tehran and Muscat does not mean the strait will resume navigation immediately.

According to a message posted by Iran’s foreign ministry on Telegram, spokesperson Esmail Baghaei said the joint statement between Iran and Oman is under review and has entered its final drafting stage. The negotiations are "professional and continuously moving forward," and as long as a "specific third party" does not intervene to obstruct, the final agreement can be sealed.

Iran and Oman have been discussing management plans for the Strait of Hormuz over the past few days. The waterway has become the focal point of the five‑month war between the United States and Iran, with massive volumes of crude oil and natural gas needing to pass through it. During the closure, daily supplies of several million barrels of crude have been disrupted.

Baghaei did not mention whether the United States was involved in the talks, only stating that the closure of the Strait of Hormuz was caused by attacks launched by the United States and Israel. U.S. President Trump said on Tuesday night in Los Angeles that an agreement on the Strait of Hormuz was imminent.

Nevertheless, Iran’s state television on Wednesday quoted insiders saying that even if Iran and Oman finalize an agreement, the Strait of Hormuz may not open right away; the actual resumption of navigation still depends on whether "U.S. behavior changes." This comment shows a clear gap between the parties on the agreement’s effect and subsequent conditions.

As signals increase that the Strait of Hormuz could reopen, international oil prices steadied on Wednesday, with London Brent crude slipping slightly to about $79 a barrel. If shipping resumes, the millions of barrels of daily crude supply lost to the conflict could gradually return to the market.

Although fighting between the United States and Iran has paused, there is still no consensus on how to end the five‑month war, and several disputes—including Iran’s nuclear program—remain unresolved, with no formal negotiations agreed upon. Consequently, whether the Iran‑Oman shipping pact can truly lead to the Strait of Hormuz’s reopening remains to be seen.
Before the close of the article, October‑delivery Brent futures fell 0.30% to $79.12 a barrel, while September‑delivery West Texas Intermediate futures dropped 0.69% to $75.25 a barrel.

items.title: AI投資外溢！富國銀行：資本財與工業股受惠 留意期中選舉政治風險
items.title_en: AI Investment Spillover! Wells Fargo: Capital Goods and Industrial Stocks to Benefit, Beware of Midterm Election Political Risks
paras: 富國銀行 (Wells Fargo) 表示，科技巨擘大舉投入人工智慧 (AI) 的資本支出正開始「外溢」至整體經濟，可望進一步推升工業類股表現。
富國策略師 Ohsung Kwon 周二 (4 日) 發布報告指出，隨著資料中心建設持續擴張，工業類股將成為主要受惠者。其中，生產建廠所需機械、設備與工具的資本財企業，已成為目前「與 AI 關聯度最高」的族群之一，其走勢與半導體產業愈來愈同步。
Kwon 說：「近幾個月來，資本財類股已成為與半導體連動性最高的產業。」他指出，已有多項跡象顯示 AI 投資正逐漸傳導至工業企業。
富國預估，美國 7 月製造業活動以逾四年來最快速度擴張，非 AI 相關資本支出也較去年同期成長 10%，而商業及工業貸款則同步加速成長。
近幾個月來，投資人持續加碼所謂「舊經濟」(Old Economy) 產業，使標普 500 指數今年的市場領漲族群出現輪動。
截至目前為止，工業類股今年已上漲 20%，漲幅僅次於能源與資訊科技類股。

開拓重工受惠資料中心需求

建築設備大廠開拓重工 (CAT-US) 便是代表性受惠企業之一，該公司周二股價大漲 5.6%，主因資料中心建設需求推升第 2 季獲利成長。
有「景氣金絲雀」之稱的建築設備大廠開拓重工 (Caterpillar) (CAT-US) 便是代表性受惠企業之一，該公司周二盤前公布的財報優異，終場股價大漲 5.6%。
財報顯示，在 AI 資料中心建設帶動發電設備與工程機械需求帶動下，開拓重工的營收與獲利雙雙超越華爾街預期，單季營收更首度突破 200 億美元，該公司並同步上修全年營收成長展望、下修關稅成本預估。
開拓重工的能源與運輸部門近年已超越開拓重工最廣為人知的挖土機等工程機械業務，成為公司規模最大、成長最快的事業。投資人也因此將開拓重工與 Vertiv、GE Vernova 等電力設備業者一同納入 AI 概念股範疇。
但這也讓開拓重工獲得空頭注意，以做空次貸危機聞名的投資人、電影《大賣空》原型貝瑞 (Michael Burry) 6 月 30 日曾透露，他首度放空開拓重工。
貝瑞當時表示，該公司在過去一年大漲超過 150% 之後，已成為 AI 投資熱潮下估值最昂貴的受惠者之一，他說：「開拓重工吸引了我的注意。我從未放空過開拓重工，它過去一直是我偏好多頭布局的標的。」
在貝瑞放空消息曝光當天，開拓重工股價在 7 月 2 日創下每股超過 1070 美元的歷史新高。該股周二以每股 876.54 美元作收。

政治阻力成最大風險

Kwon 預估，目前全美約有 40 座大型資料中心正在興建，另有超過 100 座規劃中，主要集中於德州、喬治亞州、維吉尼亞州及賓州。
他說：「我們現在看到，已經投入營運的資料中心正為所在地區帶來經濟效益。如果這真的是未來的新趨勢，那麼 AI 投資外溢至整體經濟的影響，目前還只是在非常初期的階段。」
不過，Kwon 也提醒，資料中心快速擴張已引發居民對電價、水資源消耗及社區環境衝擊的疑慮，未來恐面臨愈來愈大的政治阻力。
他說：「我認為資料中心建設最大的風險，就是政治反彈，尤其隨著 11 月美國期中選舉逼近，這項議題可能受到更多關注。」
paras_en: Wells Fargo stated that the capital expenditures of tech giants on artificial intelligence (AI) are starting to 'spillover' into the overall economy, which is expected to further boost the performance of industrial stocks.

Wells Fargo strategist Ohsung Kwon released a report on Tuesday, indicating that industrial stocks will be the main beneficiaries as data center construction continues to expand. Among them, capital goods companies that produce machinery, equipment, and tools for manufacturing are now one of the groups with the highest correlation with AI, and their trend is becoming increasingly synchronized with the semiconductor industry.

Kwon said, 'In recent months, capital goods stocks have become the industry with the highest correlation with semiconductors.' He pointed out that there are already many signs that AI investment is gradually being transmitted to industrial companies.

Wells Fargo expects that US manufacturing activity in July will expand at the fastest pace in over four years, with non-AI related capital expenditures growing 10% year-over-year, and commercial and industrial loans also accelerating.
In recent months, investors have continued to increase their holdings of so-called 'old economy' industries, resulting in a rotation of the leading groups in the S&P 500 index this year.
So far this year, industrial stocks have risen by 20%, second only to energy and information technology stocks.

Caterpillar, a heavy equipment manufacturer, is a representative beneficiary, with its stock price surging 5.6% on Tuesday due to the boost in data center construction demand and a strong earnings growth in the second quarter.

Caterpillar, also known as the 'canary in the coal mine' of the economy, released its financial report on Tuesday, which exceeded Wall Street expectations, with revenue and profit both surpassing expectations, and quarterly revenue exceeding $20 billion for the first time. The company also revised up its full-year revenue growth forecast and lowered its tariff cost estimate.

However, this has also drawn the attention of short-seller Michael Burry, who is known for his role in the subprime mortgage crisis and the movie 'The Big Short'. On June 30, Burry revealed that he had shorted Caterpillar for the first time, stating that the company had become one of the most expensive beneficiaries of the AI investment boom after rising by over 150% in the past year.
On the day Burry's short position was exposed, Caterpillar's stock price reached a historic high of over $1,070 on July 2. The stock closed at $876.54 on Tuesday.

Kwon estimates that there are currently around 40 large data centers under construction in the US, with over 100 planned, mainly in Texas, Georgia, Virginia, and Pennsylvania. He said, 'We are now seeing that the data centers that have been put into operation are bringing economic benefits to the local areas. If this is a new trend, then the impact of AI investment spilling over into the overall economy is still in its very early stages.'

However, Kwon also warned that the rapid expansion of data centers has raised concerns among residents about electricity prices, water consumption, and community environmental impact, and may face increasing political resistance in the future. He said, 'I think the biggest risk for data center construction is political backlash, especially as the US midterm elections approach in November, this issue may receive more attention.'

paras_en: On August 6, pre‑market Taiwan stock news:

1. The Taiwan Stock Exchange closed at 44,611.6 points on the 5th, up 1,250.94 points or 2.88%. Trading volume swelled to NT$1.14 trillion, returning to the trillion‑dollar level, and the index broke through both its monthly and quarterly moving averages. The three major institutional investors net‑bought a total of NT$100.406 billion, with foreign investors leading the charge by net‑buying NT$90.308 billion – the third‑largest net purchase on record. They also bought more than 117,000 lots of the 00631L Yuanta Taiwan 50 Leveraged 2 ETF. The top individual stock purchases were Kai‑Fund (39,000 lots), Foxconn (36,000 lots), Wistron (35,000 lots) and Lite‑On Technology (29,000 lots).

2. The United States and Iran may soon reach an agreement to reopen the Hormuz Strait, causing international oil prices to plunge. Hot money flowed back into Asia, lifting both Taiwan’s stock market and its currency on the 5th. The New Taiwan dollar briefly appreciated by 0.17 NT$ against the US dollar, ending the session at NT$32.315, a gain of 0.132 NT$. The combined turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets amounted to US$2.8395 billion.

3. Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced on the 5th that its July revenue reached NT$946.512 billion, a historic monthly high and making it the first Taiwanese listed company poised to achieve a trillion‑NT$ month. Revenue grew 15.18% month‑over‑month and 54.19% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first seven months hit NT$5.59 trillion, also a record for the period, up 37.89% year‑over‑year.

4. Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) held a board meeting on the 5th and passed a resolution to raise its 2024 capital expenditure cap from NT$52 billion to a maximum of NT$69.7 billion. The additional budget will mainly be used to pre‑pay for equipment needed to build capacity at its new 5A fab.

5. Stock‑king Xinyuan (5274‑TW) released its Q2 earnings on the 5th, reporting a quarterly net profit of NT$1.841 billion, up 30.2% sequentially and 188.4% year‑over‑year – a record high for a single quarter. Earnings per share were NT$40.87. For the first half of the year, net profit totaled NT$3.255 billion, a 114.71% annual increase, or NT$78.28 per share. Benefiting from the rapid growth phase of AI server construction, Xinyuan earned in the first half of this year as much as it did in the first three quarters of last year.

6. General Manager Guo Yueshe of Sih‑Power (1503‑TW) said on the 5th that global demand for the AIDC (Automatic Identification and Data Capture) supply chain remains very strong and that the tech sector is actively expanding capacity, believing demand will not decline over the next five years. Because of this strong demand, transformer shortages have emerged, but Guo noted that Sih‑Power’s advance procurement means delivery times are unaffected.

Foreign investors flipped to net buying at record speed, posting the third‑largest ever net purchase of NT$90.3 billion and snapping up more than 110,000 lots of the Yuanta Taiwan 50 Leveraged 2 ETF.
The New Taiwan dollar surged 0.132 NT$ to close at NT$32.315 as hot money returned to stocks and FX.

Largan Precision’s July revenue reached NT$4.877 billion, up 31.38% month‑over‑month, with momentum expected to continue as the company ramps up shipments this month.
Eighty‑plus Taiwan‑listed ETFs announced dividend payouts; three of them posted annualized yields exceeding 18%.
Twenty‑two overseas ETFs hit fresh highs; 00757 surged 12% in the past week, the strongest performer.
Sih‑Power’s General Manager Guo Yueshe sees global AIDC demand remaining robust, with no shortage concerns for the next five years.
Xinyuan’s Q2 profit surge set new highs for four of its stock categories, and July revenue also reached a new record.
Nanya Technology raised its 2024 capital‑expenditure ceiling to NT$69.7 billion, with a four‑year cap of NT$346.6 billion.

items.title: 力韡聲請破產切割仲裁案影響 偉訓(3032)擺脫財務包袱、股價攻漲停
items.title_en: Liwei Files for Bankruptcy to Cut Arbitration Impact; Weixun (3032) Relieves Financial Burden, Stock Soars to Upper Limit
paras: 2026年08月05日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 偉訓(3032-TW)旗下持股78%的子公司力韡，因與美國客戶Ascion的產品瑕疵仲裁案，董事會決議自8月18日起停業一年，並向法院聲請破產。公司表示，待法院完成破產程序並指派破產管理人後，力韡將退出偉訓合併財務報表，先前超額認列逾11億元的損失可望回沖，未來也不再認列力韡虧損。消息激勵偉訓股價開高後，4分鐘內即攻上漲停。
這起爭議始於2021年。力韡原為美國電動床品牌REVERIE母公司Ascion的供應商，Ascion以產品瑕疵及出貨延遲為由提出仲裁。案件歷經多年審理及三次仲裁，最終判定力韡須賠償約4,859萬美元（約新台幣15.76億元），包括產品損害、利息及律師費等。
力韡曾向美國密西根東區聯邦地方法院提起撤銷仲裁裁決之訴，但於7月23日遭駁回。由於資產不足以清償賠償金，因此董事會決議停業並向法院聲請破產。
這起仲裁案之前一直拖累偉訓。雖然美國法院日前已裁定，仲裁責任僅限於力韡，不會向上擴及母公司偉訓，但由於力韡一直納入偉訓合併財務報表，偉訓仍須認列相關損失，導致2025會計年度由前一年度每股盈餘4.61元轉為每股稅後虧損7.93元，並決定不配發股利。
如今隨著力韡啟動破產程序，待法院完成程序並指派破產管理人後，力韡將不再納入合併財務報表。偉訓表示，先前超額認列逾11億元的損失可望回沖，未來也無須再認列力韡虧損，市場認為有助於公司擺脫多年來的財務包袱。
儘管仲裁案重創獲利，偉訓本業仍維持成長。2025會計年度合併營收111.89億元，年增率51%，營業利益10.16億元，年增率110%，主要受惠於併購珀韻（AIP）帶動聲學業務，以及AI伺服器相關產品布局。展望2026年，公司將持續推動AI伺服器機櫃、ASIC散熱模組及高瓦數電源等產品放量出貨，作為未來成長動能。

paras_en: August 5, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Weixun (3032‑TW) subsidiary Liwei, which holds 78% of the shares, decided to suspend operations for one year starting August 18 and filed for bankruptcy after an arbitration case with U.S. client Ascion over product defects. The company said that once the court completes the bankruptcy process and appoints a trustee, Liwei will be removed from Weixun’s consolidated financial statements, allowing the previously over‑recorded loss of more than NT$1.1 billion to be reversed and no further Liwei losses will be recognized. The news spurred the stock to open higher and hit the daily price limit within four minutes.

The dispute dates back to 2021. Liwei was originally a supplier for Ascion, the parent of U.S. electric‑bed brand REVERIE. Ascion initiated arbitration citing product defects and delayed shipments. After years of litigation and three arbitration rounds, the final award required Liwei to pay about US$48.59 million (approximately NT$1.576 billion), covering product damages, interest and legal fees.

Liwei had sued the Eastern District of Michigan Federal Court to overturn the arbitration award, but the suit was dismissed on July 23. Because its assets are insufficient to cover the compensation, the board resolved to cease operations and file for bankruptcy.

The arbitration case had been dragging on Weixun’s results. Although a U.S. court recently ruled that liability is limited to Liwei and does not extend to the parent Weixun, Liwei’s inclusion in the consolidated statements forced Weixun to record the loss, turning the 2025 earnings per share from a profit of NT$4.61 in the prior year to a post‑tax loss of NT$7.93 and prompting a dividend suspension.

Now that Liwei has entered bankruptcy, once the court finalizes the process and appoints a trustee, Liwei will be excluded from the consolidated statements. Weixun said the previously over‑recorded loss of more than NT$1.1 billion can be reversed and no future Liwei losses will be recognized, which the market sees as freeing the company from a long‑standing financial burden.

Despite the hit to profitability from the arbitration, Weixun’s core business continues to grow. For the 2025 fiscal year, consolidated revenue reached NT$111.89 billion, up 51% year‑on‑year, and operating profit was NT$10.16 billion, up 110%, driven mainly by the acquisition of AIP (Pearl Sound) boosting acoustic business and the rollout of AI server products. Looking ahead to 2026, the company will keep scaling shipments of AI server racks, ASIC cooling modules and high‑wattage power supplies as future growth engines.

items.title: 〈環宇法說〉光通訊市場持續供不應求 美禁中國光收發器有利後市營運
items.title_en: Universal Optoelectronics Says Optical Communications Market Remains Short of Supply; US Ban on Chinese Optical Transceivers Benefits Future Operations
paras: 環宇 - KY(4991-TW) 今 (5) 日舉行法說會，受惠於 AI 資料中心，帶動公司在光電晶圓代工與自有品牌光電元件 (AOC) 需求強勁，訂單能見度可看到今 (2026) 年年底，全年出貨展望樂觀。此外，針對傳聞美國川普即將禁止進口新型的中國製光收發器，環宇 - KY 總執行長兼總裁安寶信也指出，若能禁止中國進口，對於環宇 - KY 未來營運將有加分效果。
環宇 - KY 今日舉行線上法說會，也公告第 2 季財報，環宇 - KY 第 2 季營收為 7.7 億元、季增 7.8%、年增 57.2%；單季毛利率為 43.3%、季減 11.2 個百分比、年減 5.5 個百分比；稅後純益為 1.1 億元、季減 43.8%、年增達 672%，單季 EPS 為 0.92 元。
安寶信表示，展望第 3 季除營收持續成長外，也希望公司毛利率預估維持在 44%-48%，目前營業費用約介於 750 萬至 850 萬美元，在手訂單目前可看到年底，但受到磷化銦 (InP) 基板欠缺影響，連帶使產能受到限制，不過目前公司備料狀況觀察，到今年年底前沒有問題，明年會持續連繫其他國家供應商以解決原料問題。
會中也有法人提問，環宇 - KY 第 2 季毛利率掉到 43.3%、減少 12.2% 原因。安寶信表示，主要是產品組合變化及 AOC 的產量下降，第 2 季產品占比觀察，射頻晶圓代工約 23%，光電晶圓代工約 10%，AOC61%，其他 6%，上半年稅後純益為 3 億元，較去年同期由虧轉盈，上半年 EPS 為 2.58 元。
此外，針對外電報載，川普即將禁止中國製造的資料中心光收發模組進入美國，引發中國廠商中際旭創受影響。安寶信也對此回應，因環宇 - KY 生產地點就在美國，若美系客戶要向外採購下，對環宇 - KY 來說有望成為一大契機及後市營運。
paras_en: Universal Optoelectronics (KY) (4991‑TW) held its earnings briefing today (the 5th). Benefiting from AI data centers, the company sees strong demand for its photonic wafer foundry services and its own‑brand optoelectronic components (AOC), with order visibility extending to the end of 2026 and an optimistic full‑year shipment outlook. In response to rumors that the United States under President Trump will soon ban imports of new Chinese‑made optical transceivers, CEO and President An Baoxin noted that such a ban would be a plus for Universal’s future operations.

Universal conducted an online briefing today and also released its Q2 financial results. Q2 revenue was NT$770 million, up 7.8% quarter‑over‑quarter and 57.2% year‑over‑year. The quarterly gross margin was 43.3%, down 11.2 percentage points QoQ and 5.5 points YoY. Net profit after tax was NT$110 million, down 43.8% QoQ but up 672% YoY, with earnings per share of NT$0.92 for the quarter.

An said that for Q3, besides continued revenue growth, the company expects gross margins to stay in the 44%‑48% range. Operating expenses are currently about US$7.5‑8.5 million. Existing orders can be seen through year‑end, but a shortage of indium phosphide (InP) substrates is constraining capacity. However, the company’s material inventory looks sufficient through the end of this year, and it will keep contacting suppliers in other countries next year to resolve the raw‑material issue.

During the session, an institutional investor asked why Q2 gross margin fell to 43.3%, a 12.2‑point decline. An explained that the drop was mainly due to a shift in product mix and a reduction in AOC production. In Q2, product composition was roughly: RF wafer foundry 23%, photonic wafer foundry 10%, AOC 61%, and other 6%. For the first half of the year, net profit after tax was NT$300 million, turning a loss into a profit year‑over‑year, and H1 EPS was NT$2.58.

Regarding reports that the Trump administration will ban Chinese‑made data‑center optical transceiver modules from entering the United States, which could affect Chinese supplier Zhongji Xuchuang, An responded that Universal’s production sites are located in the U.S. If American customers need to source abroad, this could become a major opportunity for Universal’s future operations.

items.title: 2027科技預算1823億元史上最高 國科會：加碼AI算力、帶動中小微企業轉型AI化
items.title_en: Taiwan's 2027 Budget for Science and Technology Reaches NT$182.3 Billion, Highest in History
paras: 明 (2027) 年度中央總預算案已籌編完成，國科會主委吳誠文今 (5) 日表示，明年科技預算再創新高，達新台幣 1,823 億元，較今 (2026) 年成長約 9.47%，重點包括加碼投入主權 AI 算力與基礎建設，打造智慧國家 2.0，並藉由科技產業優勢帶動中小微企業轉型與 AI 化。
吳誠文表示，台灣雖然已經具有半導體與 AI 硬體產業的深厚實力，然而強敵環伺不能掉以輕心，必須持續不斷提升科技研發實力及國際競爭力。在全球地緣政治局勢與 AI 科技競合之際，台灣除了強化半導體與 AI 產業優勢以鞏固科技戰略地位及經濟繁榮之外，也正面臨產業結構轉型的關鍵階段，應該要藉科技產業優勢帶動社會各行各業繁榮。
吳誠文說明，雖然今 (2026) 年的中央總預算還在立法院討論，但行政院已經完成了明年總預算的規劃，明年科技預算將創新高來到 1,823 億元，相較於今年成長約 9.47%，其中最重要的是主權 AI 算力與基礎建設加碼投入，打造智慧國家 2.0，並藉科技產業優勢帶動中小微企業轉型與 AI 化，促進社會各行業全面繁榮。
吳誠文強調，明年行政院科技預算，首先要保障基礎學術研究穩定成長，並重點投入全球競逐的高效能運算、量子科技、智慧機器人、矽光子與光通訊、主權 AI 等「AI 新十大建設」關鍵科技及「五大信賴產業」關鍵科技。
吳誠文指出，例如：一、大南方新矽谷 84 億，加速建構南台灣 AI 產業生態系；二、 晶創台灣 207 億，落實「優勢延續、國際拓展、應用創新、永續調適」四大半導體政策支柱與產業技術布局；三、次世代通訊 4 億，掌握低軌通訊衛星產業發展契機，建構 6G 通訊產業優勢；四、智慧機器人 22 億，推動智慧機器人研發與產業生態系建構。
五、太空計畫三期 69 億，發展低軌通訊衛星與前瞻遙測衛星系統，建構國際太空產業合作契機；六、海洋科技方案 22 億，發展科技以推動海域安全科技化、海洋產業智慧化、海洋文化生活化；七、淨零科技 108 億，發展淨零與碳循環科技，推動實際場域驗證及社區實作以加速產業化；高齡科技 16 億元，推動高齡科技研發、應用服務系統開發、場域驗證、產業化等。
吳誠文指出，明年起行政院也將整合中央各部會能量推動「智慧國家 2.0」計畫，與地方政府合作把 AI 科技轉化為社會各行各業 AI 化的應用，進一步讓智慧化的中小微企業蓬勃發展，邁向全民智慧生活圈。
paras_en: The 2027 central government budget has been completed, and National Science Council (NSC) Chairman Wu Ching-wen announced on May 5 that the budget for science and technology will reach a new high of NT$182.3 billion, a 9.47% increase from last year. The focus will be on investing in sovereign AI computing power and infrastructure, creating a smart nation 2.0, and using technology industry advantages to drive the transformation and AI of small and medium-sized enterprises.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that although Taiwan has a deep foundation in semiconductor and AI hardware industries, it cannot be complacent with the strong competition surrounding it. It must continue to improve its technological research and development capabilities and international competitiveness. In the context of global geopolitics and AI technology competition, Taiwan not only needs to strengthen its semiconductor and AI industry advantages to consolidate its technological strategic position and economic prosperity, but also faces a critical stage of industrial structural transformation.

Wu Ching-wen explained that although the 2026 central government budget is still being discussed in the Legislative Yuan, the Executive Yuan has completed the planning for next year's budget. Next year's science and technology budget will reach a new high of NT$182.3 billion, a 9.47% increase from this year. The most important thing is to invest in sovereign AI computing power and infrastructure, create a smart nation 2.0, and use technology industry advantages to drive the transformation and AI of small and medium-sized enterprises, promoting the overall prosperity of various industries.

Wu Ching-wen emphasized that next year's Executive Yuan science and technology budget will first ensure the stable growth of basic academic research and focus on investing in key technologies such as high-performance computing, quantum technology, intelligent robots, silicon photonics and optical communication, and sovereign AI. The "AI New Ten Major Construction" and "Five Major Trust Industries" key technologies will also be prioritized.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the South Taiwan AI Industry Ecosystem Construction Project, which will invest NT$84 billion to accelerate the construction of the AI industry ecosystem in southern Taiwan. Two is the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) project, which will invest NT$207 billion to implement the "Continuation of Advantage, International Expansion, Innovation, and Sustainable Adaptation" four-pillar semiconductor policy and industry technology layout.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the Next-Generation Communication Project, which will invest NT$4 billion to grasp the opportunity of low-orbit communication satellite industry development, build a 6G communication industry advantage. Two is the Intelligent Robot Project, which will invest NT$22 billion to promote the development of intelligent robots and the construction of the robot industry ecosystem.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the Space Plan Phase 3, which will invest NT$69 billion to develop low-orbit communication satellites and advanced remote sensing satellite systems, build international space industry cooperation opportunities. Two is the Ocean Technology Scheme, which will invest NT$22 billion to develop technology to promote ocean security, ocean industry intelligence, and ocean cultural living. Three is the Zero-Carbon Technology Project, which will invest NT$108 billion to develop zero-carbon and carbon cycle technologies, promote practical field verification and community implementation to accelerate industrialization.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the Aging Technology Project, which will invest NT$16 billion to promote aging technology research and development, application service system development, field verification, and industrialization.

items.title: 氣立2026年上半年轉盈稅後賺進4803萬元每股純益0.69元
items.title_en: LIT 2026 First Half Year Turned Profit After Tax of NT$48.03 Million Per Share, Net Profit of NT$0.69 Per Share
paras: 氣動與電控自動化元件廠氣立 (4555-TW) 今 (5) 日公布最新獲利，2026 年第二季稅後賺 4549 萬元，季增 16.91 倍，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.65 元， 上半年稅後賺進 4803 萬元，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.69 元。
氣立 2026 年第二季營收 4.92 億元，毛利率 32.95%，季增 2.82 個百分點，年增 0.87 個百分點，第二季稅後賺 4549 萬元，季增 16.91 倍，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.65 元。上半年稅後賺進 4803 萬元，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益爲 0.69 元。

氣立主管指出，以精密金屬製造為主的浙江平湖廠，受惠於 AI 興起所帶動 PCB 產業等生產設備需求增加，且機器人相關零組件訂單持續增長，加上歐洲客戶上半年度需求開始回溫，原有汽車與農機等業務亦維持平穩，使精密金屬製造業績始終維持相對高檔水準；而氣動及電控元件部分，由於台北廠與經銷商合力接獲半導體封測廠專案訂單、上海廠在大陸農業機械、液冷相關設備、新能源與儲能等業務開發有成下，整體營收也較去年同期提升；伴隨者泰國廠今年起正式投入貢獻集團營收；使上半年度營運增長。
氣立除了營收維持增長外，近年來積極推動的產品優化設計及產能重新配置計畫也見到成效，不但有效降低生產成本與提升效率外，更直接反映在毛利率上，從去年第二季起回升至 30% 以上，至今年第二季更近 33%。
在新產業及新產品開發上，氣立上半年在半導體封測專案訂單挹注與既有客戶持續下單下，相關無桿缸等產品出貨增長，半導體產業客群營收占比提升；至於超音波流量感測器部分，客戶驗證時間較原先預期長，但經過不斷測試與產品修正，從第二季末起也開始由原先測試訂單轉變為小額正式訂單，客群也由半導體廠務及 PCB 拓展至水資源，生技等產業，逐漸有效轉化為營收。
paras_en: LIT (4555-TW) announced its latest earnings today (5th), with a net profit of NT$45.49 million in the second quarter, a 16.91 times increase from the same period last year, with a net profit of NT$0.65 per share. The company's revenue for the first half of 2026 was NT$492 million, with a gross margin of 32.95%, a 2.82 percentage point increase from the same period last year, and a net profit of NT$48.03 million, a 16.91 times increase from the same period last year, with a net profit of NT$0.69 per share.

LIT's management pointed out that the company's precision metal manufacturing business in Zhejiang Pinghu, which is mainly focused on AI-driven PCB production equipment and machine-related component orders, has seen a significant increase in demand, and the company's European customers have started to see a rebound in demand in the first half of the year, while the company's existing automotive and agricultural machinery businesses have maintained a stable performance, resulting in a relatively high level of performance in the precision metal manufacturing industry.

In addition, the company's pneumatic and electrical control components business has seen a significant increase in revenue due to the joint efforts of the Taipei factory and distributors to receive semiconductor packaging factory project orders, and the Shanghai factory has seen significant growth in agricultural machinery, liquid cooling-related equipment, new energy, and energy storage businesses, resulting in a significant increase in revenue compared to the same period last year.
The company's Thai factory has officially started contributing to the group's revenue this year, resulting in a significant increase in revenue in the first half of the year.

In addition to revenue growth, the company's product optimization design and capacity reconfiguration plan, which has been actively promoted in recent years, has also seen significant results, not only effectively reducing production costs and improving efficiency, but also directly reflected in the gross margin, which has risen to over 30% since last year's second quarter, and reached 33% in the second quarter of this year.

In terms of new industries and new product development, LIT has seen significant growth in revenue from its semiconductor packaging project orders and existing customers' continued orders, with related products such as no-cylinder products seeing increased shipments, and the semiconductor industry customer group's revenue proportion increasing.

As for the ultrasonic flow sensor part, the customer verification time was longer than expected, but after continuous testing and product modification, it started to convert from testing orders to small formal orders from the end of the second quarter, and the customer group expanded from semiconductor factories and PCBs to water resources, biotechnology, and other industries, gradually converting into revenue.

items.title: 驗32次全合格！台糖受波及自主下架估損2.43億元 喊告福懋求償
items.title_en: Passed All 32 Tests! Taiwan Sugar Sues Fu Mao for Estimated NT$243 Million Loss After Unfair Delisting
paras: 台糖今 (5) 日表示，針對今年 5 月向福懋（1225-TW）來自中聯的粗油，因中聯油品發生苯胼芘超標情事，連帶導致台糖商品無辜下架、商譽受損，保守估計光是沙拉油商品損失就高達 2.43 億元。台糖澄清，公司向來嚴格落實自主品管，今年以來沙拉油產品經主管機關及相關單位檢驗 32 次全部合格，部分民代與媒體稱其為毒油與事實不符。台糖目前正委請律師與會計師研商，將正式向福懋提告求償。
台糖指出，公司今年 5 月向福懋公司採購粗油，雖然均依據合約規範辦理規格檢驗，並將檢測結果與契約不符的粗油直接拒收，但福懋所提供來自中聯公司的油源，事後卻被驗出苯胼芘超標，進而引發市場疑慮與爭議。這項外購原料問題致使台糖產品遭受無妄之災，不僅面臨產品下架命運，更有形與無形地重創公司建立多年的商譽與品牌形象。
為了正視聽並維護權益，台糖重申公司對產品品質經營的堅持，強調從今年初至今，台糖沙拉油已累計接受各界抽驗多達 32 次，檢驗結果每次均安全過關，完全符合衛生標準。對於部分外界民代與媒體頻繁以毒油形容台糖產品，台糖對此表達遺憾與無奈，並呼籲外界勿再以訛傳訛，協助導正市場資訊。
針對後續法律行動與求償作業，台糖說明，內部目前已著手進行相關損失評估。初步保守估算，光是沙拉油產品下架與銷售停擺所產生的直接經濟損失，就至少達到 2.43 億元，至於商譽等無形損失金額則尚在精算評估中。台糖後續將儘快與律師及會計師進行研商，完成整體損失清算後，會正式向福懋公司提出告訴並爭取合法賠償。
paras_en: Taiwan Sugar announced today (May 5) that the crude oil it purchased in May from Fu Mao (1225‑TW), sourced from Zhonglian, was found to exceed the benzopyrene limit. This contamination forced Taiwan Sugar's products to be unjustly removed from shelves and damaged its goodwill, with a conservative estimate that losses from its salad oil alone total NT$243 million. Taiwan Sugar clarified that it has always strictly enforced independent quality control; since the start of the year its salad oil has been tested 32 times by regulators and related agencies, all passing, and it disputes claims by some legislators and media that the oil is poisonous.

The company noted that it purchased the crude oil from Fu Mao in May, conducting specification inspections as required by contract and rejecting any oil that did not meet the terms. However, the oil supplied by Fu Mao from Zhonglian was later found to contain excessive benzopyrene, sparking market concerns and controversy. This external raw‑material issue caused Taiwan Sugar’s products to suffer an unwarranted disaster, leading not only to product delisting but also to both tangible and intangible damage to the goodwill and brand image built over years.

To address the situation and protect its rights, Taiwan Sugar reiterated its commitment to product quality, emphasizing that since the beginning of the year its salad oil has undergone up to 32 random inspections, each passing safely and fully complying with health standards. The company expressed regret and helplessness over repeated references by some legislators and media to its products as "toxic oil," urging the public to stop spreading misinformation and help correct market information.

Regarding future legal action and compensation, Taiwan Sugar explained that it has begun internal loss assessments. A preliminary conservative estimate puts the direct economic loss from the salad oil’s delisting and sales suspension at at least NT$243 million, while intangible losses such as goodwill are still being precisely calculated. Taiwan Sugar will promptly consult with lawyers and accountants, and after finalizing the overall loss settlement, it will formally file a lawsuit against Fu Mao to seek lawful compensation.

items.title_en: 22 Overseas ETFs Hit New Highs, 00757 Surges 12% in a Week
paras: 美股昨日全面大漲，市場一面消化美伊談判進展，一面迎接密集企業財報。大型科技與半導體股成為今 (5) 日市場反彈的主要推力，更帶動在台掛牌的 22 檔海外股票 ETF 股價創新高。進一步統計這 22 檔 ETF 自 7/30 低點以來漲幅，統一 FANG+ ETF(00757-TW) 以雙位數的反彈幅度居冠。

根據 CMoney 統計，股市從 7/30 自低點強彈至今，已有 22 檔海外股票 ETF 領先大盤創高，其中，統一 FANG+ ETF(00757-TW) 以 12.35% 居榜單之冠，今 (5) 日股價收 141.95 元，再次改寫歷史新高。其餘則依序為國泰網路資安 (00875-TW)、大華美國 MAG7+(009815-TW)、華南永昌 NASDAQxT(009818-TW) 及復華 S&P500 成長 (00924-TW)。
​統一 FANG+ ETF 經理人林良一表示 7 月美股劇烈分化，主因在於科技巨頭財報遇賣壓、聯準會鷹派異議首現、油價反覆。月底微軟、亞馬遜雲端財報強勁，那指終結連六黑，蘋果財測疲弱走跌，AI 變現者與硬體落後者分歧擴大。
展望後市，林良一表示，資本支出逐步轉化為雲端營收，構成續強底氣；惟鷹派異議、殖利率高檔、油價震盪仍是變數。反彈品質取決財報能否延續 AI 變現力，領軍族群已收斂至 AI 基建巨頭。短線回檔可伺機布局，長線定期定額累積。

paras_en: US stocks surged yesterday, with the market digesting progress in US-Iran talks and receiving a slew of corporate earnings reports. Large-cap tech and semiconductor stocks drove the market's rebound today, also pushing the 22 overseas-listed stock ETFs to new highs. Further analysis shows that these 22 ETFs have risen by double-digit percentages since their low point on July 30.

According to CMoney statistics, the stock market has rebounded strongly from its low point on July 30, with 22 overseas stock ETFs leading the pack in reaching new highs. Among them, the Uni-FANG+ ETF (00757-TW) topped the list with a 12.35% rebound, closing at NT$141.95 yesterday and setting a new historical high.
The other ETFs in the list, in order, are Cathay Network Security (00875-TW), Dahua America MAG7+ (009815-TW), Southern China Everbright NASDAQxT (009818-TW), and Fuhwa S&P 500 Growth (00924-TW).

Uni-FANG+ ETF manager Lin Liang-yi attributed the recent market volatility to the July US stock market's sharp differentiation, citing the sell-off in tech giants' earnings reports, the emergence of hawkish dissent among Fed officials, and the fluctuations in oil prices.

However, Lin noted that the capital expenditure is gradually being converted into cloud revenue, forming a strong foundation for the market. Nevertheless, the hawkish dissent, high interest rates, and oil price volatility remain variables that could impact the market's rebound.

The quality of the rebound will depend on whether the earnings reports can sustain the momentum of AI-driven growth, with the leading group narrowing down to AI infrastructure giants. Short-term pullbacks can be used as opportunities to position, while long-term investors can accumulate through regular, systematic investments.
