items.title: SpaceX市值一夕蒸發2250億美元 AI燒錢疑慮蓋過亮眼財報
items.title_en: SpaceX Loses $225 Billion in Market Value Overnight as AI Spending Concerns Overshadow Strong Earnings
paras: SpaceX (SPCX-US) 週三 (5 日) 股價狂瀉逾 13% 至每股 108.27 美元，市值一夕蒸發 2,250 億美元，主因市場對公司大舉投入人工智慧 (AI) 基礎建設的資本支出感到憂心，儘管第二季營收優於市場預期、虧損也持續收斂，但龐大的現金消耗仍成為投資人關注焦點。
這是 SpaceX 自 6 月完成歷史性 IPO 後首度公布財報。執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 在法說會上同步描繪未來藍圖，將公司 2030 年營收目標上調至 1 兆美元，較原先預期提前一年達成，並宣布計畫最快於明年開始部署太空資料中心，進一步強化 AI 基礎設施布局。
不過，相較於營運成長，市場更聚焦於現金流表現。SpaceX 今年前兩季自由現金流均呈現大幅流出，其中第二季資本支出高達 183.6 億美元，較去年同期增加約 28 億美元。
公司表示，第二季資本支出中約有 158 億美元投入 AI 業務，顯示 AI 已成為目前最重要的投資方向。IPO 前，SpaceX 便將自己定位為兼具太空、衛星通訊與 AI 基礎建設的科技公司，希望藉此吸引更多投資人。
從營運表現來看，AI 業務仍是成長最快的部門。第二季營收年增 247% 至 26 億美元，主要受惠於新增雲端服務合約，單季帶來約 16 億美元 AI 基礎設施收入，同時整體運算容量也提升至 1.4GW。
然而，目前最主要的獲利來源仍是以 Starlink 為核心的衛星通訊業務。受惠於 Starlink 用戶數較去年同期倍增，第二季該部門營收年增 66% 至 43 億美元，持續穩居公司最大收入來源，客戶涵蓋一般消費者、企業、政府，以及航空、郵輪等商業市場。
財報顯示，SpaceX 第二季營收達 78.1 億美元，高於市場預估的 68.1 億美元；調整後每股虧損為 0.09 美元，也較去年同期的每股虧損 0.34 美元明顯改善。
不過，研究機構 Vital Knowledge 指出，雖然營收與 EBITDA 表現亮眼，但自由現金流惡化反映公司正以前所未見的速度投入 AI 建設，短期內將持續對財務造成壓力，這也是市場對財報反應偏向保守的主因。
SpaceX 由馬斯克於 2002 年創立，目前業務涵蓋三大領域，包括太空發射 (Space)、衛星通訊 (Connectivity) 與人工智慧 (AI)。其中，Starlink 衛星網路仍是公司規模最大的業務，IPO 後則積極擴大 AI 基礎設施布局，希望打造新的成長引擎。
SpaceX IPO 發行價為每股 135 美元，上市後股價一度衝破 200 美元，但近期已明顯回落，較高點蒸發逾 1 兆美元市值，顯示市場對公司長期成長前景仍抱持期待，但對短期高額 AI 投資與現金流壓力保持審慎態度。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) saw its stock price plummet by over 13% to $108.27 per share on Wednesday, wiping out $225 billion in market value, as investors expressed concerns over the company's massive capital expenditures on artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, despite beating market expectations for revenue and narrowing losses in the second quarter.

This was SpaceX's first earnings report since its historic IPO in June. CEO Elon Musk outlined the company's future plans during the earnings call, raising the 2030 revenue target to $1 trillion, a year ahead of schedule, and announcing plans to start deploying space data centers as early as next year to further strengthen its AI infrastructure.

However, the market was more focused on the company's cash flow performance. SpaceX reported significant outflows in free cash flow for the first two quarters of the year, with capital expenditures reaching $18.36 billion in the second quarter, a $2.8 billion increase from the same period last year.

The company stated that approximately $15.8 billion of the second-quarter capital expenditures were invested in AI businesses, indicating that AI has become the most important investment direction. Prior to its IPO, SpaceX positioned itself as a technology company with a focus on space, satellite communications, and AI infrastructure, aiming to attract more investors.

In terms of operating performance, the AI business remains the fastest-growing segment. Second-quarter revenue increased by 247% year-over-year to $2.6 billion, primarily driven by new cloud service contracts, which generated approximately $1.6 billion in AI infrastructure revenue for the quarter, with total computing capacity also increasing to 1.4GW.

However, the primary source of profit remains the satellite communications business, centered around Starlink. Driven by a doubling of Starlink users compared to the same period last year, second-quarter revenue for this segment increased by 66% year-over-year to $4.3 billion, continuing to be the company's largest source of revenue, with customers spanning individual consumers, enterprises, governments, and commercial markets such as aviation and cruises.

The earnings report showed that SpaceX's second-quarter revenue reached $7.81 billion, exceeding market estimates of $6.81 billion, with adjusted loss per share of $0.09, a significant improvement from the loss per share of $0.34 in the same period last year.

However, research firm Vital Knowledge noted that while revenue and EBITDA performance were strong, the deterioration in free cash flow reflects the company's unprecedented investment in AI construction, which will continue to put pressure on its finances in the short term, making this the primary reason for the market's conservative reaction to the earnings report.

Founded by Musk in 2002, SpaceX currently operates in three main areas: space launch (Space), satellite communications (Connectivity), and artificial intelligence (AI). Among these, the Starlink satellite network remains the company's largest business, while it has been actively expanding its AI infrastructure layout since its IPO, aiming to create a new growth engine.

SpaceX's IPO issue price was $135 per share, and its stock price once surged above $200 after listing, but has since fallen back, with over $1 trillion in market value evaporating from its peak, indicating that the market still expects long-term growth prospects but remains cautious about the company's short-term high AI investments and cash flow pressure.

items.title: 〈財報〉格芯搭上AI順風車！矽光子需求帶旺第二季業績
items.title_en: <Earnings> GlobalFoundries Rides AI Wave! Silicon Photonics Boost Q2 Results
paras: 晶圓代工業者格芯 (格羅方德 / GlobalFoundries)(GFS-US) 周三 (5 日) 公布 2026 會計年度第二季 (截至 6 月 30 日) 財報，受惠人工智慧 (AI) 資料中心帶動矽光子晶片需求，營收與調整後每股盈餘均優於華爾街預期。
格芯第二季營收為 17.9 億美元，高於 LSEG 統計分析師平均預估的 17.7 億美元；調整後稀釋每股盈餘為 0.46 美元，同樣優於市場預期的 0.44 美元。
格芯主要生產特殊應用晶片，產品廣泛用於通訊、資料中心、汽車、工業及消費性電子設備。隨著科技公司擴大 AI 基礎設施投資，市場對格芯矽光子晶片的需求逐步升溫。
矽光子技術以光訊號取代傳統電訊號傳輸資料，能提高 AI 資料中心內部的資料傳輸速度並降低能源消耗。在 AI 模型規模擴大、運算系統需要連接更多處理器之際，高速且節能的資料傳輸技術日益重要，也成為格芯新的成長動能。
展望第三季，格芯預估營收為 18.9 億美元，上下浮動 2,500 萬美元，大致符合分析師預估的 18.8 億美元。以公司預測區間計算，第三季營收可能落在 18.65 億至 19.15 億美元之間。
不過，格芯第二季調整後自由現金流為負 300 萬美元，明顯低於去年同期的正 2.77 億美元，顯示公司儘管營收與獲利優於預期，現金流表現仍面臨壓力。
此外，格芯今年 3 月對以色列同業 Tower Semiconductor 提起訴訟，指控對方侵犯 11 項半導體製造專利，涉及智慧型手機及其他電子產品所使用的晶片。這起專利爭議仍在進行中。
截稿前，格芯 (GFS-US) 周三盤中股價下跌 4.17%，每股暫報 49.85 美元。
paras_en: Wafer foundry GlobalFoundries (GFS-US) released its fiscal 2026 second‑quarter results (ended June 30) on Wednesday, May 5. Benefiting from AI data‑center driven demand for silicon‑photonic chips, both revenue and adjusted earnings per share beat Wall Street expectations.
Q2 revenue was $1.79 billion, above the LSEG analysts’ average forecast of $1.77 billion. Adjusted diluted EPS came in at $0.46, also topping the market’s $0.44 consensus estimate.

GlobalFoundries primarily manufactures specialty‑application chips used broadly in communications, data centers, automotive, industrial and consumer electronics. As tech companies expand AI infrastructure investments, demand for GlobalFoundries’ silicon‑photonic chips is warming up.

Silicon‑photonic technology replaces traditional electrical signals with light to transmit data, increasing data‑transfer speed inside AI data centers while cutting energy consumption. With AI models growing larger and compute systems needing to link more processors, high‑speed, energy‑efficient data transfer is becoming increasingly important and serves as a new growth driver for GlobalFoundries.

Looking ahead to Q3, GlobalFoundries projects revenue of $1.89 billion, give or take $25 million, roughly in line with analysts’ estimate of $1.88 billion. Based on the company’s guidance range, Q3 revenue could fall between $1.865 billion and $1.915 billion.

However, adjusted free cash flow in Q2 was a negative $3 million, sharply down from a positive $277 million in the same quarter last year, indicating that despite better‑than‑expected revenue and profit, cash‑flow pressure remains.

In addition, GlobalFoundries filed a lawsuit in March against Israeli peer Tower Semiconductor, alleging infringement of 11 semiconductor‑manufacturing patents covering chips used in smartphones and other electronic products. The patent dispute is ongoing.
Before the market close, GlobalFoundries (GFS-US) shares fell 4.17% in mid‑day trading, quoted at $49.85 per share.

items.title: 27年老將帶隊出走！Google痛失四名AI大將 盤中股價一度跌逾5%
items.title_en: 27-Year Veteran Leads Exit! Google Loses Four AI Leaders, Stock Drops Over 5% Intraday
paras: Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下 Google 周三 (5 日) 宣布大幅改組人工智慧 (AI) 領導團隊。Google DeepMind 共同創辦人兼執行長哈薩比斯 (Demis Hassabis) 將卸下日常營運職務，改任 DeepMind 董事長及 Alphabet 首席科學家；在 Google 任職 27 年的首席科學家狄恩 (Jeff Dean) 則將離職創業。消息公布後，Alphabet 股價盤中一度下跌逾 5%。
截稿前，Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 周三盤中股價下跌 3.50%，每股暫報 364.43 美元。
Google DeepMind 技術長 Koray Kavukcuoglu 將升任資深副總裁，接手哈薩比斯多數職責，全面負責 Google 的 AI 模型開發，並直接向 Alphabet 執行長皮查伊 (Sundar Pichai) 報告。他也將領導下一代主要 AI 模型 Gemini 4 的研發。
哈薩比斯表示，現在是交出 DeepMind 日常營運工作的適當時機，讓他能把時間與心力放在更宏觀的 AI 發展方向。未來他將與皮查伊合作，處理 AI 相關的策略及全球性議題。
狄恩則將與 Google 資深研究員 Sanjay Ghemawat、Oriol Vinyals 及 Quoc Le 共同創立 AI 新創公司 Discovery Loop，由狄恩擔任執行長。新公司將採公共利益公司形式，運用 AI 自動化複雜且涉及多個步驟的科學與工程工作，加速機器學習、硬體設計、藥物研發及潔淨能源等領域的發現。
Discovery Loop 初期將聚焦自動化機器學習研究與工程流程。狄恩表示，許多科學研究包含提出假設、設計與執行實驗，再評估結果等反覆步驟，其中不少流程可以完全電腦化，這也成為公司名稱的由來。

這批離職成員均是 Google 重要 AI 技術功臣。狄恩曾共同創立 Google Brain，並主導張量處理器 (TPU) 開發；Vinyals 是蛋白質結構預測系統 AlphaFold 的重要貢獻者；Le 則參與 Google 數學推理 AI 系統研發。Google 將投資 Discovery Loop 並提供雲端及運算資源，Radical Ventures 與 Khosla Ventures 則共同領投種子輪。

這波改組正值 Google 與 OpenAI、Anthropic 競逐前沿 AI 模型的關鍵時刻。Google 近期接連流失頂尖人才，Noam Shazeer 已轉投 OpenAI，AlphaFold 諾貝爾獎得主 John Jumper 也加入 Anthropic。Google 最新版 Gemini 3.5 Pro 遲遲尚未推出，部分 Meta 模型在特定評測中的表現也已超越 Gemini，令投資人逐漸失去耐心。
與此同時，Google 大幅提高 AI 基礎設施支出，預估全年資本支出最高達 2,050 億美元，上一季自由現金流更首度轉為負值。在 AI 競爭升溫、支出急速擴張之際，核心主管與研究人才相繼異動，使市場更加擔憂 Google 能否維持 AI 領先地位。
paras_en: Alphabet (GOOGL-US) subsidiary Google announced on Wednesday (the 5th) a major reshuffle of its artificial intelligence (AI) leadership team. DeepMind co‑founder and CEO Demis Hassabis will step down from day‑to‑day operations to become DeepMind chairman and Alphabet chief scientist; Jeff Dean, who has been Alphabet’s chief scientist for 27 years, will leave to start his own venture. After the news broke, Alphabet’s share price fell more than 5% at one point during trading.
By the time of writing, Alphabet (GOOGL-US) was down 3.50% in mid‑day trading, with the stock quoted at $364.43 per share.

DeepMind’s chief technology officer Koray Kavukcuoglu will be promoted to senior vice president, taking over most of Hassabis’s duties and assuming full responsibility for Google’s AI model development, reporting directly to Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai. He will also lead the development of the next‑generation flagship AI model Gemini 4.

Hassabis said the timing is right for him to hand over DeepMind’s daily operations so he can focus his time and energy on broader AI development directions. Going forward he will work with Pichai on AI strategy and global issues.

Dean will co‑found an AI startup called Discovery Loop with senior Google researchers Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals and Quoc Le, serving as its CEO. The new company will be organized as a public‑interest corporation and will use AI to automate complex, multi‑step scientific and engineering work, accelerating discoveries in machine learning, hardware design, drug development and clean energy.

Discovery Loop will initially focus on automating machine‑learning research and engineering workflows. Dean explained that many scientific projects involve repeated cycles of hypothesis generation, experiment design and execution, and result evaluation, many of which can be fully computerised – the inspiration for the company’s name.

These departing members are key AI contributors at Google. Dean co‑founded Google Brain and led the development of Tensor Processing Units (TPUs); Vinyals was a major contributor to the protein‑structure prediction system AlphaFold; Le helped develop Google’s mathematical reasoning AI system. Google will invest in Discovery Loop and provide cloud and compute resources, while Radical Ventures and Khosla Ventures will co‑lead the seed round.

The reshuffle comes as Google battles OpenAI and Anthropic for cutting‑edge AI models. Google has recently lost top talent, with Noam Shazeer moving to OpenAI and AlphaFold Nobel laureate John Jumper joining Anthropic. Google’s latest Gemini 3.5 Pro has yet to launch, and some Meta models have already outperformed Gemini in specific benchmarks, eroding investor patience.

At the same time, Google has sharply increased AI infrastructure spending, forecasting annual capital expenditures up to $205 billion, and its free cash flow turned negative for the first time last quarter. Amid escalating AI competition and rapidly expanding spend, the turnover of senior executives and researchers is heightening market concerns about Google’s ability to maintain its AI leadership.

items.title: AI投資外溢！富國銀行：資本財與工業股受惠 留意期中選舉政治風險
items.title_en: AI Investment Spillover! Wells Fargo: Capital Goods and Industrial Stocks to Benefit, Beware of Midterm Election Political Risks
paras: 富國銀行 (Wells Fargo) 表示，科技巨擘大舉投入人工智慧 (AI) 的資本支出正開始「外溢」至整體經濟，可望進一步推升工業類股表現。
富國策略師 Ohsung Kwon 周二 (4 日) 發布報告指出，隨著資料中心建設持續擴張，工業類股將成為主要受惠者。其中，生產建廠所需機械、設備與工具的資本財企業，已成為目前「與 AI 關聯度最高」的族群之一，其走勢與半導體產業愈來愈同步。
Kwon 說：「近幾個月來，資本財類股已成為與半導體連動性最高的產業。」他指出，已有多項跡象顯示 AI 投資正逐漸傳導至工業企業。
富國預估，美國 7 月製造業活動以逾四年來最快速度擴張，非 AI 相關資本支出也較去年同期成長 10%，而商業及工業貸款則同步加速成長。
近幾個月來，投資人持續加碼所謂「舊經濟」(Old Economy) 產業，使標普 500 指數今年的市場領漲族群出現輪動。
截至目前為止，工業類股今年已上漲 20%，漲幅僅次於能源與資訊科技類股。

開拓重工受惠資料中心需求

建築設備大廠開拓重工 (CAT-US) 便是代表性受惠企業之一，該公司周二股價大漲 5.6%，主因資料中心建設需求推升第 2 季獲利成長。
有「景氣金絲雀」之稱的建築設備大廠開拓重工 (Caterpillar) (CAT-US) 便是代表性受惠企業之一，該公司周二盤前公布的財報優異，終場股價大漲 5.6%。
財報顯示，在 AI 資料中心建設帶動發電設備與工程機械需求帶動下，開拓重工的營收與獲利雙雙超越華爾街預期，單季營收更首度突破 200 億美元，該公司並同步上修全年營收成長展望、下修關稅成本預估。
開拓重工的能源與運輸部門近年已超越開拓重工最廣為人知的挖土機等工程機械業務，成為公司規模最大、成長最快的事業。投資人也因此將開拓重工與 Vertiv、GE Vernova 等電力設備業者一同納入 AI 概念股範疇。
但這也讓開拓重工獲得空頭注意，以做空次貸危機聞名的投資人、電影《大賣空》原型貝瑞 (Michael Burry) 6 月 30 日曾透露，他首度放空開拓重工。
貝瑞當時表示，該公司在過去一年大漲超過 150% 之後，已成為 AI 投資熱潮下估值最昂貴的受惠者之一，他說：「開拓重工吸引了我的注意。我從未放空過開拓重工，它過去一直是我偏好多頭布局的標的。」
在貝瑞放空消息曝光當天，開拓重工股價在 7 月 2 日創下每股超過 1070 美元的歷史新高。該股周二以每股 876.54 美元作收。

政治阻力成最大風險

Kwon 預估，目前全美約有 40 座大型資料中心正在興建，另有超過 100 座規劃中，主要集中於德州、喬治亞州、維吉尼亞州及賓州。
他說：「我們現在看到，已經投入營運的資料中心正為所在地區帶來經濟效益。如果這真的是未來的新趨勢，那麼 AI 投資外溢至整體經濟的影響，目前還只是在非常初期的階段。」
不過，Kwon 也提醒，資料中心快速擴張已引發居民對電價、水資源消耗及社區環境衝擊的疑慮，未來恐面臨愈來愈大的政治阻力。
他說：「我認為資料中心建設最大的風險，就是政治反彈，尤其隨著 11 月美國期中選舉逼近，這項議題可能受到更多關注。」
paras_en: Wells Fargo stated that the capital expenditures of tech giants on artificial intelligence (AI) are starting to 'spillover' into the overall economy, which is expected to further boost the performance of industrial stocks.

Wells Fargo strategist Ohsung Kwon released a report on Tuesday, indicating that industrial stocks will be the main beneficiaries as data center construction continues to expand. Among them, capital goods companies that produce machinery, equipment, and tools for manufacturing are now one of the groups with the highest correlation with AI, and their trend is becoming increasingly synchronized with the semiconductor industry.

Kwon said, 'In recent months, capital goods stocks have become the industry with the highest correlation with semiconductors.' He pointed out that there are already many signs that AI investment is gradually being transmitted to industrial companies.

Wells Fargo expects that US manufacturing activity in July will expand at the fastest pace in over four years, with non-AI related capital expenditures growing 10% year-over-year, and commercial and industrial loans also accelerating.
In recent months, investors have continued to increase their holdings of so-called 'old economy' industries, resulting in a rotation of the leading groups in the S&P 500 index this year.
So far this year, industrial stocks have risen by 20%, second only to energy and information technology stocks.

Caterpillar, a heavy equipment manufacturer, is a representative beneficiary, with its stock price surging 5.6% on Tuesday due to the boost in data center construction demand and a strong earnings growth in the second quarter.

Caterpillar, also known as the 'canary in the coal mine' of the economy, released its financial report on Tuesday, which exceeded Wall Street expectations, with revenue and profit both surpassing expectations, and quarterly revenue exceeding $20 billion for the first time. The company also revised up its full-year revenue growth forecast and lowered its tariff cost estimate.

However, this has also drawn the attention of short-seller Michael Burry, who is known for his role in the subprime mortgage crisis and the movie 'The Big Short'. On June 30, Burry revealed that he had shorted Caterpillar for the first time, stating that the company had become one of the most expensive beneficiaries of the AI investment boom after rising by over 150% in the past year.
On the day Burry's short position was exposed, Caterpillar's stock price reached a historic high of over $1,070 on July 2. The stock closed at $876.54 on Tuesday.

Kwon estimates that there are currently around 40 large data centers under construction in the US, with over 100 planned, mainly in Texas, Georgia, Virginia, and Pennsylvania. He said, 'We are now seeing that the data centers that have been put into operation are bringing economic benefits to the local areas. If this is a new trend, then the impact of AI investment spilling over into the overall economy is still in its very early stages.'

However, Kwon also warned that the rapid expansion of data centers has raised concerns among residents about electricity prices, water consumption, and community environmental impact, and may face increasing political resistance in the future. He said, 'I think the biggest risk for data center construction is political backlash, especially as the US midterm elections approach in November, this issue may receive more attention.'

items.title: Meta又出包！平台驚見兒童性虐待內容 祖克柏傳向印度道歉
items.title_en: Meta Faces Another Scandal! Platform Discovers Child Sexual Abuse Content, Zuckerberg Said to Apologize to India
paras: 印度當地媒體周三 (5 日) 報導，Meta(META-US)執行長祖克柏 (Mark Zuckerberg) 已就旗下平台出現兒童性虐待內容、深偽內容及營運疏失，向印度政府表達歉意。
印度財經媒體《Moneycontrol》引述消息人士指出，祖克柏的道歉是在 Meta 高層與印度政府官員周二會面期間轉達。Meta 旗下主要社群平台包括臉書 (Facebook) 與 Instagram，該公司尚未回應置評要求，因此目前相關說法仍未獲 Meta 公開證實。
印度政府 7 月曾要求 Meta 移除 Instagram 上宣傳兒童性虐待內容的廣告及貼文。根據《英國廣播公司》(BBC) 當時引述印度電子與資訊科技部高階官員報導，政府也要求 Meta 在 7 天內提出說明，交代含有這類內容的廣告為何能在平台上出現。
Meta 當時表示，公司對兒童性虐待內容採取零容忍政策，並持續加強相關偵測系統。不過，這起事件仍引發外界質疑 Meta 的內容審查與廣告審核機制是否存在漏洞。
此外，印度電子與資訊科技部上月也曾傳喚 Meta 高層，原因是臉書一度限制印度總理莫迪 (Narendra Modi) 發布的一則貼文。Meta 解釋，該貼文是因營運操作錯誤而遭意外封鎖。
印度海德拉巴警方另對 Meta 印度負責人 Arun Srinivas 立案調查，涉及臉書上出現涉嫌以侮辱方式描繪莫迪的影片。這些事件使 Meta 同時面臨兒童安全、深偽內容、政治貼文處理及平台管理等多重壓力。
印度今年進一步收緊網路內容規範，縮小社群平台針對使用者發布內容所享有的免責保障，也提高平台高層可能承擔的法律風險。自今年 2 月起，若法院或政府通報內容違法，平台必須在 3 小時內移除，遠短於原先的 36 小時，否則可能失去相關法律保障。
paras_en: Indian local media reported on Wednesday (the 5th) that Meta (META-US) CEO Mark Zuckerberg has apologized to the Indian government for child sexual abuse content, deep‑fake material and operational lapses appearing on its platforms.

India's financial news outlet Moneycontrol, citing sources, said Zuckerberg's apology was conveyed during a meeting on Tuesday between senior Meta executives and Indian government officials. Meta's main social platforms include Facebook and Instagram, and the company has not responded to comment requests, so the statements have not been publicly confirmed by Meta.

The Indian government in July had asked Meta to remove ads and posts on Instagram that promoted child sexual abuse content. According to the BBC, which at the time quoted senior officials from India's Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, the government also demanded that Meta explain within seven days why such ads were allowed to appear on the platform.

Meta said at the time that it has a zero‑tolerance policy toward child sexual abuse content and is continuously strengthening its detection systems. Nevertheless, the incident has sparked doubts about possible gaps in Meta's content moderation and ad‑review mechanisms.

In addition, the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology last month summoned senior Meta officials after Facebook briefly restricted a post by Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Meta explained that the post was inadvertently blocked due to an operational error.

Hyderabad police have also opened an investigation against Meta India head Arun Srinivas over a video on Facebook that allegedly depicted Modi in a defamatory manner. These events put Meta under multiple pressures concerning child safety, deep‑fake content, political post handling and overall platform management.

India has further tightened internet content regulations this year, narrowing the liability shield that social platforms enjoy for user‑generated content and increasing the legal risk for senior executives. Since February, if a court or government notifies illegal content, platforms must remove it within three hours—far shorter than the previous 36‑hour window—or risk losing legal protections.

items.title: 停滯性通膨警訊？美國7月服務業需求穩健、成本飆升 就業指標卻陷萎縮
items.title_en: Stagnating Inflation Warning? US July Services Demand Robust, Costs Surge, Yet Employment Index Shrinks
paras: 美國 7 月服務業持續擴張，新訂單與商業活動加速成長，顯示第三季初國內需求仍具韌性。不過，投入成本大幅上升、就業指標重新陷入萎縮，也讓市場看到經濟成長與通膨壓力並存的訊號，支持 Fed 在勞動市場尚未明顯惡化之際，繼續將政策重心放在通膨。
美國供應管理協會 (ISM) 周三 (5 日) 公布，7 月非製造業指數由 6 月的 54.0 微升至 54.1，略低於市場預期的 54.5，但仍高於象徵景氣榮枯分界的 50。服務業占美國經濟活動比重超過三分之二，其穩定擴張顯示消費與企業需求仍然強勁。

美國 7 月 ISM 非製造業指數細項：(50 為榮枯線)


商業活動生產指數報 59.1，前值 55.4
 新訂單指數報 57.2，前值 55.1
 僱傭指數報 47.4，前值 51.2
 供應商交貨指數報 52.8，前值 54.4
 存貨指數報 51.4，前值 51.2
 價格指數報 70.3，前值 67.7
 未完成訂單指數報 50.9，前值 54.9
 新出口訂單指數報 52.0，前值 50.4
 進口指數報 51.8，前值 49.4
 庫存景氣指數報 52.5，前值 52.6




新訂單、商業活動加速 世界盃帶來短期助力

ISM 服務業新訂單指數由 55.1 升至 57.2，高於市場預期的 55.9；商業活動指標則攀至 5 個月高點。包括零售、運輸與倉儲及營建在內，共有 13 個服務產業回報業務成長，僅 4 個產業萎縮。
新訂單增加也受到出口需求改善帶動，進出口指標雙雙升至 4 月以來最高。不過，未完成訂單僅小幅增加，增速較前月明顯放緩。供應商交貨指數由 54.4 降至 52.8，但仍高於 50，代表供應商交貨速度持續偏慢，也加重企業的成本負擔。
標普全球公布的 7 月美國服務業採購經理人指數 (PMI) 終值則由 6 月的 51.2 大幅升至 54.6，不僅高於 53.6 的初值，更創 2025 年 10 月以來最高，寫下 2024 年 5 月以來最大單月升幅。
標普全球調查顯示，服務業新業務增速創 19 個月最高，企業對未來一年營運活動的信心也升至去年 11 月以來最佳。民間部門就業人數更自 4 月以來首度增加。綜合 PMI 反映，第三季初美國國內生產毛額 (GDP) 折合年率可能成長 2.3%，高於第二季調查暗示的 1.5%。
不過，標普全球市場財智首席商業經濟學家 Chris Williamson 提醒，7 月成長加快部分來自暫時性因素。面向消費者的服務業受惠世界盃與美國獨立紀念日活動，需求增幅創逾 4 年最大；月初地緣政治不確定性下降及油價回落，也為企業帶來助力。隨著波斯灣衝突在月底升溫，這些利多可能逐漸消退。

成本飆升、就業萎縮 Fed 仍可緊盯通膨

價格與就業成為 ISM 報告中最令人擔憂的部分。7 月服務業支付價格指數由 67.7 躍升至 70.3，遠高於市場預期的 65.0。美伊臨時協議破裂後，油價及汽油價格回升，推高服務與原物料成本；供應商交貨延遲也進一步加劇價格壓力。
標普全球調查同樣顯示，企業投入成本漲幅創 2022 年 11 月以來最大，綜合企業售價則以一年來最快速度上漲。經濟學家也警告，即使油價回落，人工智慧投資熱潮仍可能使基礎通膨保持高檔。
與需求穩健、價格上漲形成對比的是，ISM 服務業就業指數由 6 月的 51.2 驟降至 47.4，低於市場預期，並創 3 月以來最大萎縮幅度。該指標過去 5 個月有 4 個月低於 50，顯示企業在成本居高不下、獲利空間受到擠壓之際，招聘態度轉趨謹慎。
不過，ISM 就業指數過去並非官方服務業就業人數的可靠預測指標。經濟學家仍將目前勞動市場形容為「低招聘、低裁員」狀態，認為就業尚未明顯失速，Fed 仍可優先處理通膨問題。
聯準會 (Fed) 上周將聯邦資金利率目標區間維持在 3.5% 至 3.75%，但有 3 名官員主張升息 1 碼 (25 個基點)。市場預估，周五(7 日) 公布的 7 月非農就業人數將增加 8 萬人，高於 6 月的 5.7 萬人，失業率料維持在 4.2%。
paras_en: US services continued to expand in July, with new orders and business activity accelerating, indicating that domestic demand remains resilient into early Q3. However, sharply higher input costs and a renewed contraction in employment indicators signal a mix of growth and inflation pressures, supporting the Fed’s focus on inflation while the labor market has not yet clearly deteriorated.

The Institute for Supply Management (ISM) released its July non‑manufacturing index on Wednesday (the 5th), which rose slightly to 54.1 from June’s 54.0, just below the market forecast of 54.5 but still well above the 50‑point threshold that separates expansion from contraction. Services account for more than two‑thirds of US economic activity, and their steady expansion shows that consumer and corporate demand remain strong.

July ISM non‑manufacturing sub‑indices (50 is the break‑even line):
- Business Activity Production Index: 59.1, prior 55.4
- New Orders Index: 57.2, prior 55.1
- Employment Index: 47.4, prior 51.2
- Supplier Deliveries Index: 52.8, prior 54.4
- Inventories Index: 51.4, prior 51.2
- Prices Index: 70.3, prior 67.7
- Backlog of Orders Index: 50.9, prior 54.9
- New Export Orders Index: 52.0, prior 50.4
- Imports Index: 51.8, prior 49.4
- Inventory‑Related Business Index: 52.5, prior 52.6

New orders and business activity accelerated, helped by a short‑term boost from the World Cup.
The ISM services new‑orders index rose to 57.2 from 55.1, beating the market’s 55.9 estimate, while the business activity gauge hit a five‑month high. Thirteen service sectors—including retail, transportation and warehousing, and construction—reported growth, with only four sectors contracting.
Export demand also improved, lifting both import and export indices to their highest levels since April. However, the backlog of orders grew only modestly, with the pace slowing markedly from the prior month. Supplier deliveries fell to 52.8 from 54.4 but stayed above 50, indicating that slower deliveries continue to add cost pressure on firms.

S&P Global’s final July US services PMI jumped sharply to 54.6 from June’s 51.2, well above the preliminary 53.6 reading and the highest since October 2025, marking the biggest single‑month rise since May 2024.
The survey showed the fastest new‑business growth in 19 months and the strongest confidence in operating activities for the next year since November last year. Private‑sector employment rose for the first time since April. The composite PMI suggests that US real GDP could grow at an annualised 2.3% in early Q3, above the 1.5% implied by the second‑quarter survey.
Chief Business Economist Chris Williamson warned that part of July’s acceleration stems from temporary factors: consumer‑facing services benefited from the World Cup and Independence Day celebrations, delivering the biggest demand surge in over four years; reduced geopolitical uncertainty and lower oil prices early in the month also helped firms. Those tailwinds may fade as tensions in the Persian Gulf intensify at month‑end.

Costs surged and employment contracted, but the Fed can still focus on inflation.
Price and employment figures were the most concerning parts of the ISM report. The services‑sector paid‑prices index jumped to 70.3 from 67.7, far above the market’s 65.0 expectation. After the collapse of the US‑Iran temporary agreement, oil and gasoline prices rebounded, pushing up service and raw‑material costs; slower supplier deliveries further amplified price pressure.
S&P Global’s survey likewise showed that input‑cost growth was the strongest since November 2022, while firms raised their selling prices at the fastest pace in a year. Economists warned that even if oil prices retreat, the ongoing AI investment boom could keep core inflation elevated.
In contrast to robust demand and rising prices, the ISM services employment index plunged to 47.4 from June’s 51.2, missing forecasts and marking the biggest decline since March. The gauge has been below 50 in four of the past five months, indicating that firms are pulling back hiring as costs stay high and profit margins are squeezed.
Nevertheless, the ISM employment index has not historically been a reliable predictor of official services‑sector employment. Economists still describe the labor market as a "low‑hiring, low‑layoff" environment, believing that employment has not yet clearly stalled, allowing the Fed to keep prioritising inflation.
The Federal Reserve kept its target range for the federal funds rate at 3.5%‑3.75% last week, though three officials advocated a 25‑basis‑point hike. Markets expect July non‑farm payrolls released on Friday the 7th to rise by 80,000 to 57,000 in June, with the unemployment rate likely holding at 4.2%.

items.title: 別等通膨失控才下重手！卡什卡里催Fed現在就小步升息
items.title_en: Don't Wait for Inflation to Spiral Out of Control, Kashkari Urges Fed to Raise Rates Now
paras: 明尼阿波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里 (Neel Kashkari) 周三 (5 日) 表示，Fed 現在應開始以小幅、漸進的方式升息，以抑制仍高於 2% 目標的通膨，避免物價壓力日後變得根深柢固，迫使央行採取更激烈的緊縮措施。他並指出，今年底前升息 3 次「並非不可能」。
卡什卡里接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，企業獲利表現亮眼，消費者與勞動市場也都維持穩健。在這種情況下，他看不出目前貨幣政策對經濟構成明顯限制，因此 Fed 仍有進一步升息的必要。
他表示，Fed 並不需要大幅提高利率，而是應隨著更多經濟數據出爐，逐步把利率往上調整。卡什卡里認為，與其等到通膨問題惡化後被迫大幅升息，不如現在就以較小幅度開始行動。
卡什卡里說：「現在正是隨著更多數據出爐，開始緩步調高利率的時候。」他補充，如果通膨接下來持續橫向發展，甚至進一步惡化，Fed 就必須開始逐步調整利率，讓物價漲幅重新回落。
被問及 Fed 是否可能在今年底前升息 3 次時，卡什卡里回答「並非不可能」。不過，他尚未確定 9 月會議應採取何種政策行動，強調仍須觀察接下來公布的經濟數據，因此目前並未直接承諾支持 9 月升息。
卡什卡里是上周聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 會議中主張升息 1 碼的 3 名異議官員之一，其餘 9 名具投票權的官員則支持按兵不動，將聯邦資金利率目標區間維持在 3.5% 至 3.75%。Fed 今年以來始終維持利率不變，在勞動市場趨於穩定、通膨仍明顯高於目標之際，官員對政策方向的看法逐漸分歧。
卡什卡里上周五發布聲明警告，若決策官員等待太久，讓高通膨逐漸固化，日後可能被迫採取更激進的升息措施。他認為，現在先以較小幅度採取行動，能降低未來必須大幅緊縮政策的風險。
雖然中東緊張局勢一度緩和、油價回落，帶動 6 月通膨數據略有改善，但卡什卡里對前景仍感到不安。他認為，一連串供給面衝擊持續對消費者造成壓力，Fed 仍有更多工作要做。9 月 15 日至 16 日政策會議前公布的通膨與就業數據，將是他判斷是否支持升息的關鍵。
相較之下，同樣擁有今年 FOMC 投票權的費城聯準銀行總裁鮑爾森 (Anna Paulson) 認為，目前利率已對經濟形成「溫和限制」，支持 Fed 繼續按兵不動。她並表示，上周支持維持利率不變，對她而言「並不是一個難以決定的選擇」。
卡什卡里也主張，Fed 應繼續向外界清楚說明，面對不同經濟情境時可能採取何種政策反應，讓市場與民眾了解央行的決策邏輯。他的看法與新任 Fed 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 近期減少前瞻指引的作法形成對比。卡什卡里表示，清楚解釋 Fed 的「反應函數」仍有價值，之後可由市場自行判斷政策走向。
對於華許是否曾要求他改變立場，卡什卡里表示並未受到壓力。華許延續歷任 Fed 主席的作法，在 FOMC 會議前致電同僚交換意見，並告訴卡什卡里，應按照自己認為對經濟最正確的方式投票。
據知情人士透露，華許在上周會議上也曾提出減少 FOMC 政策會議次數的可能性。卡什卡里對此表示，他不認為每年舉行多少次會議存在一個「神奇數字」，暗示會議頻率仍應視央行決策需求而定。
paras_en: Minneapolis Federal Reserve President Neel Kashkari stated on Wednesday that the Fed should start raising interest rates in small, gradual steps to curb inflation, which remains above the 2% target, and prevent price pressures from becoming entrenched, forcing the central bank to take more drastic measures later.

In an interview with CNBC, Kashkari noted that corporate profits are strong, and consumers and the labor market are stable, leading him to believe that monetary policy is not currently a significant constraint on the economy, and thus the Fed still needs to raise rates further.

Kashkari emphasized that the Fed does not need to raise interest rates sharply, but rather should gradually adjust them as more economic data becomes available. He believes it is better to act now with smaller increments rather than waiting for inflation to worsen and being forced to raise rates more sharply.

Kashkari was one of three dissenting officials who advocated for a 1% rate hike at last week's Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, while the other nine voting members supported keeping the federal funds rate target range at 3.5% to 3.75%. The Fed has maintained its rates unchanged this year, and officials' views on policy direction have become more divided as the labor market stabilizes and inflation remains above target.

Although tensions in the Middle East have eased and oil prices have fallen, leading to a slight improvement in June's inflation data, Kashkari remains uneasy about the outlook. He believes that a series of supply-side shocks continues to put pressure on consumers, and the Fed must take action. However, he did not commit to supporting a rate hike in September, stressing that the data to be released before the September 15-16 meeting will be crucial in making a decision.

In contrast, Philadelphia Federal Reserve President Anna Paulson, who also has a vote on the FOMC this year, believes that the current interest rates have imposed a 'moderate restraint' on the economy, supporting the Fed's decision to hold rates steady. She stated that her decision to support maintaining rates last week was 'not a difficult choice'.

Kashkari also argued that the Fed should continue to clearly communicate its potential policy responses to different economic scenarios, allowing the market and the public to understand the central bank's decision-making logic. His views contrast with new Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh's recent reduction in forward guidance. Kashkari believes that clearly explaining the Fed's 'reaction function' still has value, and the market can then judge the direction of policy.

When asked if Warsh had asked him to change his stance, Kashkari replied that he had not been pressured. Warsh told him to vote according to what he believes is most accurate for the economy. The market is currently pricing in a slight likelihood of a rate hike in September, with a higher probability of action in October.

items.title: AMD對AI自信十足 市場卻關注供給能否跟上
items.title_en: AMD Exudes Confidence in AI, but Market Worries About Supply
paras: AMD 在 2026 年第二季交出了超越市場預期的財務報告，營收達 115.4 億美元，年增率高達 50%。其中，資料中心部門營收年成長 107%，成為推動公司成長的核心引擎。儘管營運表現亮眼，且管理層對 2027 年資料中心營收翻倍給出了明確的量化承諾，但市場的關注焦點已從「需求是否存在」轉向「供給能否跟上」。
在產品線方面，AMD 旗艦 AI 晶片 MI450 已於 2026 年第三季末啟動初始出貨，預計在第四季進入大規模量產爬坡，並於 2027 年進一步加速。
高盛對此持樂觀看法，維持「買進」評級並將目標價設為 640 美元。高盛分析認為，AMD 完全具備在 2027 年實現資料中心收入超過 400 億美元的條件，且伺服器 CPU 的強勁成長將有效對沖 GPU 產品量產初期的毛利率壓力。
然而，摩根大通抱持較為審慎的態度，將評級定為「中性」。該行指出，MI450 組合帶來的毛利率稀釋效應將於 2027 年上半年逐步顯現，且來自 OpenAI 及 Meta 的認股權證稀釋機制也將對長期獲利產生影響。摩根大通認為，雖然 AMD 擁有多年期的成長機會，但首款機架規模產品的量產執行風險仍不容忽視。
供應鏈的瓶頸被視為 AMD 兌現財測的最大變數。AMD 第二季資本支出大幅攀升至 8.08 億美元，主要用於向委外封測（OSAT）廠託管 CoWoS 先進封裝設備，以保障 Venice CPU 的產能。
匯豐指出，AMD 將設備拖管至矽品、力成等封測廠，而非台積電，這顯示出一線供應商產能幾無向上空間，且需關注二線廠低良率帶來的產出風險。
paras_en: AMD delivered a stronger-than-expected financial report for the second quarter of 2026, with revenue reaching $11.54 billion, representing a 50% year-over-year increase. The data center segment saw a 107% year-over-year growth, becoming the core driver of the company's growth. Despite the impressive operational performance and the management's clear quantitative commitment to doubling data center revenue in 2027, the market's focus has shifted from 'whether demand exists' to 'whether supply can keep up'.

In terms of product lines, AMD's flagship AI chip, MI450, started initial shipments at the end of the third quarter of 2026 and is expected to enter mass production in the fourth quarter, with further acceleration in 2027.

Goldman Sachs is optimistic, maintaining a 'buy' rating and setting a target price of $640. Goldman Sachs analysts believe that AMD is fully capable of achieving data center revenue of over $40 billion in 2027, and the strong growth of server CPUs will effectively offset the pressure on GPU product margins during the initial stages of mass production.

However, JPMorgan is more cautious, with a 'neutral' rating. The bank points out that the dilution effect of the MI450 combination on margins will gradually emerge in the first half of 2027, and the dilution mechanism of stock warrants from OpenAI and Meta will also impact long-term profitability. JPMorgan believes that while AMD has long-term growth opportunities, the execution risk of mass-producing its first rack-scale product cannot be ignored.

Supply chain bottlenecks are seen as the biggest variable in AMD's ability to deliver on its financial forecasts. AMD's capital expenditures surged to $808 million in the second quarter, mainly used to outsource advanced CoWoS packaging equipment to OSAT (outsourced semiconductor assembly and test) factories to secure the production capacity of Venice CPUs.

HSBC notes that AMD is outsourcing equipment to OSAT factories such as Siliconware and Powertech, rather than TSMC, indicating that first-tier suppliers have little room for capacity expansion, and the output risk due to the low yield of second-tier factories needs to be monitored.

items.title: SpaceX市值一夕蒸發2250億美元 AI燒錢疑慮蓋過亮眼財報
items.title_en: SpaceX Loses $225 Billion in Market Value Overnight as AI Spending Concerns Overshadow Strong Earnings
paras: SpaceX (SPCX-US) 週三 (5 日) 股價狂瀉逾 13% 至每股 108.27 美元，市值一夕蒸發 2,250 億美元，主因市場對公司大舉投入人工智慧 (AI) 基礎建設的資本支出感到憂心，儘管第二季營收優於市場預期、虧損也持續收斂，但龐大的現金消耗仍成為投資人關注焦點。
這是 SpaceX 自 6 月完成歷史性 IPO 後首度公布財報。執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 在法說會上同步描繪未來藍圖，將公司 2030 年營收目標上調至 1 兆美元，較原先預期提前一年達成，並宣布計畫最快於明年開始部署太空資料中心，進一步強化 AI 基礎設施布局。
不過，相較於營運成長，市場更聚焦於現金流表現。SpaceX 今年前兩季自由現金流均呈現大幅流出，其中第二季資本支出高達 183.6 億美元，較去年同期增加約 28 億美元。
公司表示，第二季資本支出中約有 158 億美元投入 AI 業務，顯示 AI 已成為目前最重要的投資方向。IPO 前，SpaceX 便將自己定位為兼具太空、衛星通訊與 AI 基礎建設的科技公司，希望藉此吸引更多投資人。
從營運表現來看，AI 業務仍是成長最快的部門。第二季營收年增 247% 至 26 億美元，主要受惠於新增雲端服務合約，單季帶來約 16 億美元 AI 基礎設施收入，同時整體運算容量也提升至 1.4GW。
然而，目前最主要的獲利來源仍是以 Starlink 為核心的衛星通訊業務。受惠於 Starlink 用戶數較去年同期倍增，第二季該部門營收年增 66% 至 43 億美元，持續穩居公司最大收入來源，客戶涵蓋一般消費者、企業、政府，以及航空、郵輪等商業市場。
財報顯示，SpaceX 第二季營收達 78.1 億美元，高於市場預估的 68.1 億美元；調整後每股虧損為 0.09 美元，也較去年同期的每股虧損 0.34 美元明顯改善。
不過，研究機構 Vital Knowledge 指出，雖然營收與 EBITDA 表現亮眼，但自由現金流惡化反映公司正以前所未見的速度投入 AI 建設，短期內將持續對財務造成壓力，這也是市場對財報反應偏向保守的主因。
SpaceX 由馬斯克於 2002 年創立，目前業務涵蓋三大領域，包括太空發射 (Space)、衛星通訊 (Connectivity) 與人工智慧 (AI)。其中，Starlink 衛星網路仍是公司規模最大的業務，IPO 後則積極擴大 AI 基礎設施布局，希望打造新的成長引擎。
SpaceX IPO 發行價為每股 135 美元，上市後股價一度衝破 200 美元，但近期已明顯回落，較高點蒸發逾 1 兆美元市值，顯示市場對公司長期成長前景仍抱持期待，但對短期高額 AI 投資與現金流壓力保持審慎態度。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) saw its stock price plummet by over 13% to $108.27 per share on Wednesday, wiping out $225 billion in market value, as investors expressed concerns over the company's massive capital expenditures on artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, despite beating market expectations for revenue and narrowing losses in the second quarter.

This was SpaceX's first earnings report since its historic IPO in June. CEO Elon Musk outlined the company's future plans during the earnings call, raising the 2030 revenue target to $1 trillion, a year ahead of schedule, and announcing plans to start deploying space data centers as early as next year to further strengthen its AI infrastructure.

However, the market was more focused on the company's cash flow performance. SpaceX reported significant outflows in free cash flow for the first two quarters of the year, with capital expenditures reaching $18.36 billion in the second quarter, a $2.8 billion increase from the same period last year.

The company stated that approximately $15.8 billion of the second-quarter capital expenditures were invested in AI businesses, indicating that AI has become the most important investment direction. Prior to its IPO, SpaceX positioned itself as a technology company with a focus on space, satellite communications, and AI infrastructure, aiming to attract more investors.

In terms of operating performance, the AI business remains the fastest-growing segment. Second-quarter revenue increased by 247% year-over-year to $2.6 billion, primarily driven by new cloud service contracts, which generated approximately $1.6 billion in AI infrastructure revenue for the quarter, with total computing capacity also increasing to 1.4GW.

However, the primary source of profit remains the satellite communications business, centered around Starlink. Driven by a doubling of Starlink users compared to the same period last year, second-quarter revenue for this segment increased by 66% year-over-year to $4.3 billion, continuing to be the company's largest source of revenue, with customers spanning individual consumers, enterprises, governments, and commercial markets such as aviation and cruises.

The earnings report showed that SpaceX's second-quarter revenue reached $7.81 billion, exceeding market estimates of $6.81 billion, with adjusted loss per share of $0.09, a significant improvement from the loss per share of $0.34 in the same period last year.

However, research firm Vital Knowledge noted that while revenue and EBITDA performance were strong, the deterioration in free cash flow reflects the company's unprecedented investment in AI construction, which will continue to put pressure on its finances in the short term, making this the primary reason for the market's conservative reaction to the earnings report.

Founded by Musk in 2002, SpaceX currently operates in three main areas: space launch (Space), satellite communications (Connectivity), and artificial intelligence (AI). Among these, the Starlink satellite network remains the company's largest business, while it has been actively expanding its AI infrastructure layout since its IPO, aiming to create a new growth engine.

SpaceX's IPO issue price was $135 per share, and its stock price once surged above $200 after listing, but has since fallen back, with over $1 trillion in market value evaporating from its peak, indicating that the market still expects long-term growth prospects but remains cautious about the company's short-term high AI investments and cash flow pressure.

items.title: 〈財報〉格芯搭上AI順風車！矽光子需求帶旺第二季業績
items.title_en: <Earnings> GlobalFoundries Rides AI Wave! Silicon Photonics Boost Q2 Results
paras: 晶圓代工業者格芯 (格羅方德 / GlobalFoundries)(GFS-US) 周三 (5 日) 公布 2026 會計年度第二季 (截至 6 月 30 日) 財報，受惠人工智慧 (AI) 資料中心帶動矽光子晶片需求，營收與調整後每股盈餘均優於華爾街預期。
格芯第二季營收為 17.9 億美元，高於 LSEG 統計分析師平均預估的 17.7 億美元；調整後稀釋每股盈餘為 0.46 美元，同樣優於市場預期的 0.44 美元。
格芯主要生產特殊應用晶片，產品廣泛用於通訊、資料中心、汽車、工業及消費性電子設備。隨著科技公司擴大 AI 基礎設施投資，市場對格芯矽光子晶片的需求逐步升溫。
矽光子技術以光訊號取代傳統電訊號傳輸資料，能提高 AI 資料中心內部的資料傳輸速度並降低能源消耗。在 AI 模型規模擴大、運算系統需要連接更多處理器之際，高速且節能的資料傳輸技術日益重要，也成為格芯新的成長動能。
展望第三季，格芯預估營收為 18.9 億美元，上下浮動 2,500 萬美元，大致符合分析師預估的 18.8 億美元。以公司預測區間計算，第三季營收可能落在 18.65 億至 19.15 億美元之間。
不過，格芯第二季調整後自由現金流為負 300 萬美元，明顯低於去年同期的正 2.77 億美元，顯示公司儘管營收與獲利優於預期，現金流表現仍面臨壓力。
此外，格芯今年 3 月對以色列同業 Tower Semiconductor 提起訴訟，指控對方侵犯 11 項半導體製造專利，涉及智慧型手機及其他電子產品所使用的晶片。這起專利爭議仍在進行中。
截稿前，格芯 (GFS-US) 周三盤中股價下跌 4.17%，每股暫報 49.85 美元。
paras_en: Wafer foundry GlobalFoundries (GFS-US) released its fiscal 2026 second‑quarter results (ended June 30) on Wednesday, May 5. Benefiting from AI data‑center driven demand for silicon‑photonic chips, both revenue and adjusted earnings per share beat Wall Street expectations.
Q2 revenue was $1.79 billion, above the LSEG analysts’ average forecast of $1.77 billion. Adjusted diluted EPS came in at $0.46, also topping the market’s $0.44 consensus estimate.

GlobalFoundries primarily manufactures specialty‑application chips used broadly in communications, data centers, automotive, industrial and consumer electronics. As tech companies expand AI infrastructure investments, demand for GlobalFoundries’ silicon‑photonic chips is warming up.

Silicon‑photonic technology replaces traditional electrical signals with light to transmit data, increasing data‑transfer speed inside AI data centers while cutting energy consumption. With AI models growing larger and compute systems needing to link more processors, high‑speed, energy‑efficient data transfer is becoming increasingly important and serves as a new growth driver for GlobalFoundries.

Looking ahead to Q3, GlobalFoundries projects revenue of $1.89 billion, give or take $25 million, roughly in line with analysts’ estimate of $1.88 billion. Based on the company’s guidance range, Q3 revenue could fall between $1.865 billion and $1.915 billion.

However, adjusted free cash flow in Q2 was a negative $3 million, sharply down from a positive $277 million in the same quarter last year, indicating that despite better‑than‑expected revenue and profit, cash‑flow pressure remains.

In addition, GlobalFoundries filed a lawsuit in March against Israeli peer Tower Semiconductor, alleging infringement of 11 semiconductor‑manufacturing patents covering chips used in smartphones and other electronic products. The patent dispute is ongoing.
Before the market close, GlobalFoundries (GFS-US) shares fell 4.17% in mid‑day trading, quoted at $49.85 per share.

items.title: 表面救日元、背後保美債！貝森特盯上Fed疫情時代工具
items.title_en: Surface Rescue of the Yen, Backing US Treasuries! Bessonnet Targets Fed’s Pandemic-Era Tool
paras: 美國財長貝森特正敦促聯準會 (Fed) 擴大一項原本為 2020 年美元荒設立的緊急融資工具，讓日本能以持有的美國公債作為擔保借入更多美元，用於買進日元、阻止匯率持續下跌，同時避免東京為籌措干預資金而大舉拋售美債。
日本政府周一表示，計畫動用 Fed 的「外國及國際貨幣當局附買回機制」(FIMA Repo Facility)，為未來的匯市干預籌集美元。這項安排原本不是為支撐外國貨幣設計，如今卻可能成為日本捍衛日元的重要資金來源，也引發 Fed 是否應協助川普政府執行匯率與外交政策的爭議。

抵押美債換美元 日本無須拋售 1.1 兆美元部位

FIMA 機制是在新冠疫情初期設立。當時美元融資市場陷入緊張，部分未與 Fed 建立貨幣交換管道的外國央行，可能被迫出售美國公債換取美元，進一步加劇美債市場的流動性危機。Fed 因此允許外國貨幣當局以美債作為擔保，透過附買回交易取得美元。
在新的運用方式下，日本可將美債暫時交給 Fed 換取美元，再於外匯市場賣出美元、買進日元，達到支撐匯率的目的，而不必直接處分美債。截至 5 月底，日本持有約 1.1 兆美元美國公債，真正限制其融資能力的並非抵押品不足，而是 FIMA 機制對單一交易對手設定的 600 億美元借款上限。
貝森特周日在社群平台 X 公開表示，Fed 可協助提高這項額度，並鼓勵央行未來數月擴大上限。若額度獲得調高，東京便可迅速把更多美債轉化為可供干預的美元資金，也能向市場傳達日本阻貶工具並不像表面上那樣有限，增加投機客放空日元的成本。
日本財務大臣片山皋月周一證實，東京準備使用 FIMA 機制支應未來干預。此前，美日上周五採取聯合行動，由美國與日本同步買進日元，是 1998 年以來首見。美國總統川普將這項行動形容為兩國友誼的象徵，而日元近期一度跌至 40 年低點。

華府要救的不只日元 更要避免日本拋售美債

華府支持日本穩定日元，背後也牽涉美債市場。各國捍衛本幣時，通常會出售外匯存底並買回本國貨幣，而日本的外匯存底主要由美國公債構成。若東京依循傳統方式長期干預，便可能被迫大量拋售美債。
目前美國 30 年期公債殖利率已升至 2007 年以來最高，市場承接能力備受關注。讓日本透過 FIMA 機制抵押美債取得美元，可以避免干預行動進一步推高美債殖利率，這也是華府希望促成這項安排的重要原因。
貝森特其實也能繞過 Fed，由美國財政部發行國庫券籌集美元，再透過規模約 2,000 億美元的外匯穩定基金 (Exchange Stabilization Fund) 提供資金。不過，這種方式的規模更加透明、資源也明顯有限，威嚇市場的效果不如 Fed 融資工具。
Monetary Policy Analytics 經濟學家 Derek Tang 指出，若貝森特無法取得 Fed 支持，其口頭威嚇市場的可信度就會降低。公開要求擴大 FIMA 額度，一方面可能只是無須付出成本的策略性喊話，讓市場相信日本握有更強火力；另一方面，也可能是在對聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 其他成員施壓。
弱勢日元同時推高日本通膨預期，促使投資人要求更高報酬才願意持有日本公債。日本 10 年期公債殖利率今年以來已上升 0.75 個百分點。由於日本金融機構是全球最大的跨境債權人，國內殖利率走高將降低其持有海外債券的誘因，可能吸引原本投入美債、德國公債及英國公債的資金回流日本。

Fed 要不要配合？華許獨立性迎來首次考驗

調高 FIMA 單一交易對手 600 億美元的借款上限，需要至少部分 FOMC 成員批准。Fed 通常只有在市場運作失靈或金融穩定受到威脅，並可能妨礙貨幣政策傳導時，才會擴大使用這類工具；目前的市場情況似乎尚未達到這項門檻。Fed 發言人拒絕置評。
這項要求也成為華許 5 月接掌 Fed 後，如何劃分央行與川普政府權力界線的首場考驗。Fed 的獨立性通常主要體現在利率決策，因為利率最容易受到政治壓力影響；但涉及向外國央行提供貸款等其他職能時，央行與行政部門之間的界線向來較為模糊。
華許在任命確認前提交給參議員的書面答覆中表示，Fed 在制定利率政策時擁有最高程度的獨立性，但在其他領域則不完全如此。涉及國際金融議題時，Fed 官員並不享有特殊決定權，央行應與政府及國會合作。
不過，華許上月在國會聽證會被問及類似問題時，又把 Fed 與外國央行的常設美元融資管道稱為貨幣政策的一部分。如今尚不清楚，他會把協助日本干預日元歸入央行貨幣政策，還是川普政府的外交及財政政策。貝森特與華許經常聯絡，這項決定也將檢驗新任 Fed 主席能否在配合政府與維護央行自主性之間取得平衡。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessonnet is urging the Federal Reserve (Fed) to expand an emergency financing tool originally created in 2020 to address a dollar shortage, allowing Japan to borrow more dollars against its holdings of U.S. Treasuries, use the dollars to buy yen and halt the currency’s decline, while avoiding a massive sell‑off of U.S. bonds by Tokyo to raise intervention funds.

The Japanese government said on Monday it plans to tap the Fed’s Foreign and International Monetary Authorities (FIMA) Repo Facility to raise dollars for future FX market interventions. The arrangement was not designed to support foreign currencies, but it could become a key source of funding for Japan’s defense of the yen, sparking debate over whether the Fed should help the Trump administration execute exchange‑rate and diplomatic policy.
Collateralizing U.S. Treasuries for Dollars – No Need for Japan to Sell Its $1.1 Trillion Holding

The FIMA mechanism was set up early in the COVID‑19 pandemic when the dollar funding market tightened. Some foreign central banks without a direct Fed swap line risked being forced to sell U.S. Treasuries for dollars, worsening Treasury market liquidity. The Fed therefore allowed foreign monetary authorities to use Treasuries as collateral in repo transactions to obtain dollars.

Under the new usage, Japan could temporarily hand its Treasuries to the Fed in exchange for dollars, then sell the dollars for yen in the FX market to support the exchange rate, without directly disposing of the bonds. As of the end of May, Japan holds about $1.1 trillion of U.S. Treasuries; the real constraint on its financing is not a lack of collateral but the $60 billion borrowing cap that the FIMA facility imposes on any single counterparty.

Bessonnet posted on X on Sunday that the Fed could help raise that limit and encouraged the central bank to expand the cap over the coming months. If the limit is raised, Tokyo could quickly convert more Treasuries into dollars for intervention, signalling that Japan’s anti‑depreciation tools are not as limited as they appear and raising the cost for speculators shorting the yen.

Finance Minister Shigeyuki Katayama confirmed on Monday that Tokyo is ready to use the FIMA facility for future interventions. Last Friday, the U.S. and Japan carried out a joint action buying yen in sync – the first such coordinated move since 1998. President Trump described the action as a symbol of the two countries’ friendship, as the yen had recently slipped to a 40‑year low.
Washington’s Goal Is Not Only to Save the Yen but Also to Prevent Japan from Dumping Treasuries

Washington’s support for a stable yen also ties to the Treasury market. When countries defend their own currencies, they usually sell foreign‑exchange reserves and buy back domestic money; Japan’s reserves are largely made up of U.S. Treasuries. A traditional, long‑term intervention strategy could force Tokyo to sell large amounts of Treasuries.

U.S. 30‑year Treasury yields have risen to their highest level since 2007, raising concerns about market capacity. Allowing Japan to obtain dollars by repo‑ing Treasuries through FIMA can avoid further upward pressure on Treasury yields from intervention, which is a key reason the administration backs the arrangement.

Bessonnet could also bypass the Fed by having the Treasury issue Treasury bills to raise dollars and then channel the funds through the roughly $200 billion Exchange Stabilization Fund. However, that route is more transparent, has a clearly limited resource pool, and is less effective at intimidating markets than a Fed‑backed financing tool.

Monetary‑policy analyst Derek Tang notes that if Bessonnet cannot secure Fed support, his market‑threatening rhetoric loses credibility. Publicly demanding a larger FIMA limit may be a cost‑free strategic shout‑out to make markets believe Japan has stronger firepower, or it could be an effort to pressure other members of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC).

A weak yen also lifts inflation expectations in Japan, prompting investors to demand higher yields to hold Japanese bonds. Japan’s 10‑year yield has risen 0.75 percentage points so far this year. Because Japanese financial institutions are the world’s largest cross‑border bondholders, higher domestic yields reduce the incentive to hold overseas bonds and could draw funds that were in U.S., German and U.K. Treasuries back to Japan.
Will the Fed Cooperate? Powell’s Independence Faces Its First Test

Raising the $60 billion single‑counterparty borrowing cap under FIMA would require approval from at least some FOMC members. The Fed usually expands such tools only when market functioning breaks down or financial stability is threatened in a way that could impede monetary‑policy transmission; current conditions do not appear to meet that threshold. A Fed spokesperson declined to comment.

The request also marks the first test, since Powell took over the Fed in May, of how the central bank will delineate its authority from that of the Trump administration. The Fed’s independence is most evident in rate‑setting, which is highly vulnerable to political pressure, but the line between the central bank and the executive is blurrier when it comes to lending to foreign central banks.

In a written response to senators before his confirmation, Powell said the Fed enjoys the highest degree of independence in setting interest‑rate policy, but not necessarily in other areas. On international‑finance issues, Fed officials do not have special decision‑making authority and must work with the government and Congress.

However, in a congressional hearing last month Powell referred to the Fed’s standing dollar‑funding facilities for foreign central banks as part of monetary policy. It remains unclear whether he will treat assistance to Japan’s yen‑intervention as monetary policy or as a Trump‑administration diplomatic and fiscal measure. Bessonnet’s frequent contact with Powell means the decision will test the new Fed chair’s ability to balance government cooperation with central‑bank autonomy.

items.title: 〈台幣〉熱錢回流股匯雙漲 強升1.32角收32.315元

paras: 美國與伊朗可能很快就重新開放荷姆茲海峽達成協議，國際油價應聲重挫，熱錢進一步回流亞洲，台北股匯今 (5) 日同步走揚，新台幣兌美元一度強升 1.7 角，尾盤升幅收斂，收在 32.315 元，升值 1.32 角，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 28.395 億美元。

在美日聯手干預匯市下，日元周一強勢大漲超過 2%，昨日小幅回落後，今天呈現盤整走勢。美國財政部長貝森特周二表示，日元持續疲軟可能破壞整個亞洲市場穩定，甚至引發其他貨幣競爭性貶值，因此，在有利於美國經濟的前提下，川普政府將「不惜一切代價」支持日本穩定匯市。
paras_en: The possibility of the US and Iran reaching an agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz has led to a decline in international oil prices. As a result, hot money has flowed back into Asia, causing the Taiwan stock market and currency to rise simultaneously. The Taiwanese dollar appreciated by 1.32 points to close at 32.315 against the US dollar, with a peak increase of 1.7 points. The total trading value in the Taipei foreign exchange market was $2.8395 billion.

The easing of tensions in the Middle East has led to a weakening of the US dollar, prompting foreign investors to buy Taiwanese stocks heavily, with a net buy of $9.03 billion, the third-highest single-day record. The weighted index rose by 1,250.94 points to close at 44,611.6. TSMC, the semiconductor giant, closed at $2405, up $85.

As hot money flowed back in, the Taiwanese dollar broke through the 32.4 and 32.3 thresholds against the US dollar, peaking at 32.274, with an appreciation of over 1.7 points, before closing at 32.315, up 1.32 points.

Among major Asian currencies, the Korean won appreciated the most, rising by 0.5% against the US dollar, followed by the Taiwanese dollar, which rose by 0.41%. The Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan also rose by 0.13% and 0.08%, respectively, while the Japanese yen edged up by 0.06%. Most Asian currencies rose against the US dollar.

Under the joint intervention of the US and Japan in the foreign exchange market, the Japanese yen surged by over 2% on Monday, before slightly retreating on Tuesday. On Wednesday, it presented a consolidating trend. US Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin stated on Tuesday that the continued weakness of the Japanese yen could disrupt the stability of the entire Asian market and even trigger competitive devaluations of other currencies. Therefore, the Trump administration will 'do everything' to support Japan in stabilizing its currency, as long as it is beneficial to the US economy.

items.title: 日本薪資連六月增長 勞動力市場緊俏強化日銀升息預期
items.title_en: Japan's Wages Rise for Sixth Straight Month, Boosting BOJ Rate Hike Expectations
paras: 日本勞動省周三 (5 日) 公佈的最新數據顯示，受惠於強勁的企業獲利與持續緊俏的勞動力市場，日本薪資增長勢頭穩健，進一步強化了市場對日本銀行在未來幾個月再次升息的預期。
數據顯示，日本 6 月名目薪資年增 3.4%，符合經濟學家預期，這也是名目薪資連續第五個月增幅超過 3%，創下 34 年來最長的紀錄。特別是，調整通膨後的實質薪資成長了 1.6% 至 1.7%，不僅連續第六個月上揚，更寫下 2021 年以來最長的連漲紀錄。
其中，6 月的名目薪資的加速，顯示薪資成長的動力已從波動較大的獎金 (一次性支付) 轉向更具持續性的固定薪資。這種結構性轉變正是日本銀行長期觀察的重點，認為這代表通膨正逐漸由需求驅動，而非單純的成本推升。
薪資的強勁表現主要反映了今年「春鬥」薪資談判的豐碩成果。日本最大工會聯合會 (Rengo) 爭取到超過 5% 的加薪，而大型企業如經團連 (Keidanren) 成員的平均加薪幅度更達到 5.4%。此外，超過 70% 的企業表示，加薪的主要動力是為了在緊俏的勞動力市場中招募與留住人才。
日本銀行總裁植田和男在近期的記者會中展現出鷹派立場，警示價格上行的風險正在加劇。
分析師認為，穩健的薪資增長讓日銀更有底氣維持政策正常化路徑，升息時機最快可能落在 9 月，或者不遲於今年 12 月。此外，日本政府近期與美國協調干預匯市以支撐日元，也強化了市場對於政策提前調整的預期。
儘管薪資漲勢亮眼，但食品價格通膨仍維持在高點，讓一般家庭對生活成本感到憂心。為減緩民眾壓力，日本政府計畫從明年 4 月起暫時調降食品銷售稅，並向低收入戶發放補貼。
大和證券 (Daiwa Securities) 經濟學家 Kento Minami 表示，隨著中東局勢升溫導致企業加速轉嫁成本，實質薪資在今年 11 月後仍可能面臨暫時轉負的下行壓力。
paras_en: Japan's labor ministry reported on Wednesday (5th) that the country's wages rose for the sixth consecutive month, driven by strong corporate profits and a tight labor market, further solidifying market expectations of another rate hike by the Bank of Japan in the coming months.
The data showed that Japan's nominal wages rose 3.4% in June, in line with economists' expectations, marking the fifth consecutive month of wage growth above 3%, a record 34-year high.
Notably, real wages, adjusted for inflation, grew 1.6% to 1.7%, marking the sixth consecutive month of gains and the longest streak since 2021.

The acceleration in nominal wages in June suggests that wage growth is shifting from volatile bonuses to more sustainable fixed salaries, a structural change that the Bank of Japan has been closely watching, as it believes it represents a shift from cost-push to demand-driven inflation.

The strong wage performance mainly reflects the outcome of this year's 'spring offensive' wage negotiations, with Japan's largest labor union, Rengo, securing over 5% wage hikes, while large companies, such as Keidanren members, saw an average wage increase of 5.4%.
More than 70% of companies said that wage hikes were mainly driven by the need to attract and retain talent in a tight labor market.
Bank of Japan Governor Haruhiko Kuroda has taken a hawkish stance in recent press conferences, warning of increasing risks of price hikes.

Analysts believe that stable wage growth will give the BOJ more confidence to stick to its normalization path, with the next rate hike potentially coming as early as September or not later than December.
The Japanese government's recent coordination with the US to intervene in the foreign exchange market to support the yen has also strengthened market expectations of an earlier policy adjustment.
Despite the strong wage growth, food price inflation remains high, causing concern among households about living costs.
To alleviate public pressure, the Japanese government plans to temporarily lower food sales tax from April next year and provide subsidies to low-income households.

Daiwa Securities economist Kento Minami said that with the Middle East situation escalating, leading to companies accelerating cost transfers, real wages may still face downward pressure in November and beyond.

items.title: 印度央行維持利率不變 在通膨壓力與地緣政治迷霧中尋求韌性
items.title_en: India's Central Bank Keeps Rates Unchanged Amid Inflation Pressure and Geopolitical Uncertainty
paras: 印度央行 (RBI) 周三 (5 日) 宣布將基準利率維持在 5.25%，這是央行連續第五次維持利率不變。儘管印度的零售通膨率已突破了 4% 的中期目標，由總裁馬洛特拉 (Sanjay Malhotra) 領導的貨幣政策委員會仍全體一致投票通過維持回購利率，並保持中立的政策立場。
數據顯示，受油價飆升影響，印度 6 月份消費者物價指數 (CPI) 觸及 18 個月高點 4.38%。雖然整體通膨超標，但馬洛特拉強調，核心通膨 (不含食品與能源) 仍維持在 3.7% 的適度水準，且目前尚未看到價格壓力全面擴散的跡象。
央行預計，整體通膨將在第三季達到峰值後回落，並將全年度通膨預測從 5.1% 略微下調至 5.0%。
印度目前仍是全球增長最快的主要經濟體之一，1 月至 3 月季度的 GDP 成長率達 7.8%。然而，未來的經濟前景顯得「模糊」。馬洛特拉指出，西南季風的不確定性、聖嬰現象 (El Niño) 以及中東地區 (特別是伊朗) 的衝突，都為成長帶來挑戰。
由於印度約 85% 至 90% 的燃料需求依賴進口，地緣政治引發的能源價格波動是最大的隱憂。
政策公布後，印度基準 Nifty 50 指數表現持平，10 年期國債殖利率則下滑至約 6.77%。在匯率方面，儘管印度盧比在政策公布後交易價格略有回升，但受資本外流與地緣政治導致的美元走強影響，盧比今年仍是亞洲表現最差的貨幣之一。
雖然央行目前選擇觀望，但匯豐銀行 (HSBC) 等研究機構警告，若通膨從 10 月起連續八個月維持在 5% 以上，央行將難以坐視不管。許多經濟學家預測，隨著 8 月底 GDP 數據的公布，若通膨壓力持續，印度央行可能會在 10 月或 12 月開啟升息循環。
paras_en: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) announced on Wednesday that it would keep its benchmark interest rate at 5.25%, marking the fifth consecutive time the central bank has left rates unchanged. Despite India's retail inflation rate exceeding the 4% medium-term target, the Monetary Policy Committee, led by Governor Sanjay Malhotra, unanimously voted to maintain the repo rate and retain a neutral policy stance.

Data showed that India's consumer price index (CPI) reached an 18-month high of 4.38% in June, driven by rising oil prices. Although overall inflation exceeded the target, Malhotra emphasized that core inflation (excluding food and energy) remained moderate at 3.7% and that there were no signs of broad-based price pressures.
The central bank expects overall inflation to peak in the third quarter before easing and has slightly lowered its full-year inflation forecast to 5.0% from 5.1%.

India remains one of the fastest-growing major economies, with a GDP growth rate of 7.8% in the January-March quarter. However, the economic outlook is 'uncertain'. Malhotra cited the uncertainty of the southwest monsoon, the El Niño phenomenon, and conflicts in the Middle East (particularly in Iran) as challenges to growth.
As India relies on imports for 85-90% of its fuel needs, geopolitical tensions that lead to energy price volatility are a major concern.

Following the policy announcement, the Nifty 50 index was little changed, while the 10-year government bond yield fell to around 6.77%. The Indian rupee, which had initially risen after the policy announcement, remains one of the worst-performing currencies in Asia this year due to capital outflows and a strong US dollar driven by geopolitical tensions.

Although the central bank has chosen to wait and watch for now, research institutions such as HSBC have warned that if inflation remains above 5% from October for eight consecutive months, the RBI will find it difficult to remain inactive. Many economists predict that if inflationary pressures persist, the RBI may start a rate hike cycle in October or December, following the release of GDP data at the end of August.

items.title: 公開押寶下月升息？美財長：深信日本央行總裁植田和男將「做出最佳決策」
items.title_en: US Treasury Secretary Expresses Confidence in BOJ's Decision-Making Ahead of Potential Rate Hike
paras: 美國財長貝森特周二 (4 日) 接受《NHK》專訪時表示，他認識日本央行總裁植田和男逾 15 年，深信植田會採取對日本經濟最有利的經濟決定。他並直言，日本通膨升溫部分源自弱勢日元與能源漲價，待能源回穩、日元過度疲軟獲矯正，通膨可望放緩，使日本經濟與日元進入「良性循環」。此番表態被市場解讀為華府公開押注日本央行 (BOJ) 在 9 月 17-18 日會議上升息。
貝森特長期呼籲日本升息，此次更把匯率干預與貨幣政策掛鉤。他強調，美日上週五 (7 月 31 日) 罕見聯手買入日元，為 1998 年來首度聯合買日元、2011 年後再度協調干預，意在防止弱勢日元引爆亞洲貨幣競貶、動盪蔓延。
貝森特說，「干預釋放信號，但真正改變走勢的是政策」，並稱美方透過紐約聯準銀行賣歐元買日元，此舉兼具「象徵日美合作信任」之意，也避免日本國債失錨連動推高美國長債殖利率。
他還表示，8 月底 G20 財金首長會議將與植田會面，並示警稱日本國債作為全球利率基準的角色不能動搖，美日對「日債安全健全」認知一致。
分析師指出，美國親自下場不全然為日本著想，更憂心日元套利交易反轉與日債拋售潮蔓延至美債市場。短期匯率紅線已由聯合干預劃出，但利差問題未解，BOJ 下月是否升息仍看日本薪資與核心通膨數據。
paras_en: US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen expressed her confidence in Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda's ability to make the best decisions for Japan's economy in an interview with NHK on Tuesday. Yellen, who has known Ueda for over 15 years, stated that she believes Ueda will adopt the most beneficial economic policies for Japan. She also noted that Japan's inflation is partly driven by a weak yen and rising energy prices, and that once energy prices stabilize and the yen's excessive weakness is corrected, inflation is expected to ease, leading Japan's economy and currency into a 'virtuous cycle'. This statement has been interpreted by the market as a sign that the US is openly betting on the BOJ to raise interest rates at its meeting on September 17-18.

Yellen has long been advocating for Japan to raise interest rates, and this time she linked currency intervention to monetary policy. She emphasized that the US and Japan's rare joint purchase of yen last Friday (July 31) was the first time they had done so since 1998, and the second time they had coordinated intervention since 2011, aiming to prevent a weak yen from triggering an Asian currency depreciation and spreading turmoil.

Yellen stated that 'intervention sends a signal, but it's policy that truly changes the trend', and noted that the US sold euros to buy yen through the New York Federal Reserve, which not only symbolized the trust between the US and Japan but also prevented Japan's bond yields from rising and affecting US long-term interest rates.

She also mentioned that she will meet with Ueda at the G20 finance ministers' meeting at the end of August and warned that Japan's role as a global interest rate benchmark cannot be shaken, with the US and Japan sharing the same understanding of the importance of 'Japan's bond safety and soundness'.

Analysts pointed out that the US's personal involvement is not entirely for Japan's benefit, but rather due to concerns about the potential reversal of yen arbitrage trades and the spread of Japanese bond sell-offs to the US bond market. While the short-term exchange rate red line has been drawn by the joint intervention, the issue of interest rate differentials remains unresolved, and whether the BOJ will raise interest rates next month still depends on Japan's wage and core inflation data.

items.title: 賣歐元買日元 美國財長：不惜一切代價支持日本
items.title_en: Sell Euros, Buy Yen: U.S. Treasury Secretary Says He Will Support Japan at Any Cost
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特周二（4 日）表示，在有利於美國經濟的前提下，川普政府將「不惜一切代價」支持日本穩定匯市。
他在接受《CNBC》節目採訪時稱：「我們將竭盡全力支持日本，前提是對美國經濟和美國納稅人有益。」
貝森特在節目中說，美國已加入日本提振日元的聯合干預行動，原因是日元持續疲軟可能破壞整個亞洲市場穩定，甚至引發其他貨幣競爭性貶值，「這種情況很不健康」。
他強調：「考慮到貿易流量、經濟規模以及日本對全球儲蓄市場的貢獻，保持日元穩定至關重要。日本政府明白這一點，我國很榮幸與日本合作，共同落實相關政策，協助地區穩定。」
《CNBC》指出，此次美日聯合干預是美國支持另一主要貨幣的罕見舉措，凸顯出華府對日元長期疲軟可能加劇日本通膨、打壓其他亞洲貨幣、擾亂全球市場的擔憂。
作為美日聯合行動的一部分，美國財政部出售了外匯儲備中的歐元，並將所得資金用於買入日元。貝森特說，他已向歐洲官員說明出售歐元僅為儲備資產重新配置。
「在我看來，歐元匯率已更接近均衡水準，」貝森特說，「我不會評論歐元應該在什麼位置交易，但真正的問題在於日元目前被嚴重低估，以及日本政府正在採取哪些應對措施。」
不過，貝森特也強調，購入日元只能在短期內抑制市場波動，日本仍需通過根本性政策調整應對日元走弱的深層因素。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen said on Tuesday (the 4th) that, provided it benefits the U.S. economy, the Trump administration will "support Japan at any cost" to stabilize the foreign‑exchange market.
In an interview with CNBC, she said, "We will do everything we can to support Japan, as long as it is beneficial to the U.S. economy and American taxpayers."

Yellen explained that the United States has joined Japan’s coordinated intervention to boost the yen because a persistently weak yen could undermine stability across Asian markets and even trigger competitive devaluations of other currencies, which she called "very unhealthy."

She emphasized, "Given trade flows, economic size, and Japan’s contribution to the global savings market, keeping the yen stable is crucial. The Japanese government understands this, and we are honored to work with Japan to implement the relevant policies and help regional stability."

CNBC noted that this U.S.–Japan joint intervention is a rare instance of Washington backing another major currency, highlighting concerns that a prolonged weak yen could exacerbate Japanese inflation, depress other Asian currencies, and disrupt global markets.

As part of the joint action, the U.S. Treasury sold euros from its foreign‑exchange reserves and used the proceeds to buy yen. Yellen said she has told European officials that the euro sale is simply a reallocation of reserve assets.

"In my view, the euro exchange rate is now closer to a balanced level," Yellen said. "I won’t comment on where the euro should be trading, but the real issue is that the yen is severely undervalued right now, and what measures the Japanese government is taking in response."

However, Yellen also stressed that buying yen can only dampen market volatility in the short term; Japan still needs fundamental policy adjustments to address the deeper drivers of the yen’s weakness.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】美國強調再干預，限制日圓走貶
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: U.S. Emphasizes Further Intervention, Limits Yen Depreciation
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國 7 月製造業採購經理人指數 (PMI) 升至逾四年新高，並據美國總統川普表示與伊朗的談判正在進行，警告德黑蘭這是簽署一項良好協議的最後機會，但伊朗否認與美國進行或計畫進行任何談判，促使投資人權衡美國和伊朗潛在談判的矛盾信號，並等待一系列美國勞動力市場報告，以尋找美國聯邦準備理事會 (FED) 利率走向的線索；此外，週二日本經濟財政大臣城內實稱，迄今為止日本消費者物價僅溫和上漲，中東衝突導致成本上升對物價的傳導作用仍有限，對通貨膨脹風險表達相對樂觀態度，但曾經參與東京十多年前外匯市場干預行動的前日本央行 (BOJ) 官員竹內淳表示，若日圓重新出現走弱跡象，日本和美國肯定會再次採取聯合干預行動，並據 BOJ 發布研究報告指出，日本基礎通貨膨脹加速等經濟基本面的變化，可能是近期長期利率上升的背後原因，隨著 BOJ 持續縮減公債購買規模，日本公債市場的功能明顯改善，而且市場警惕後續干預，令美元兌日圓盤整於 157.15 低點。

據美國財政部長貝森特稱，將不惜一切代價支持日本穩定匯率的努力，而且 BOJ 數據顯示，日本在最新一輪旨在提振日圓匯率的干預行動中，可能已斥資高達 365.8 億美元，但週二數據並未顯示 BOJ 經常帳戶餘額出現大規模資金外流，通常大規模資金外流被認為與干預規模存在關聯，並據美國商務部 6 月數據顯示，工廠訂單意外下降 0.3%，但耐久財訂單修正後增幅擴大至 0.5% 及貿易逆差收窄 5.6% 降至 733 億美元，而且美國勞工統計局發布的職位空缺與勞動力流動調查 (JOLTS) 顯示，截至 6 月底衡量勞動力需求職位空缺減少 17.8 萬個，但招聘人數增加且裁員人數保持低位，意味著勞動力市場依然穩定，提振美元兌日圓至 157.95 高點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於 157.70-90，支撐於 156.70-90。
◆EUR/USD
昨日澳洲 6 月數據顯示，儘管借貸成本上升，但駕駛者購買新電動汽車應對高油價，家庭支出穩健增長 0.8%，同時招聘廣告數量增加 0.8%，表明勞動力和需求仍堅挺，為必要時再加息提供空間，並據紐西蘭央行 (RBNZ) 暗示可能進一步升息，支撐澳幣和紐元，而且美元多倉規模創紀錄，引發行情急轉風險升溫，扶助歐元兌美元穩守 1.1501 低點。
隨後卡塔爾表示，調解方在結束美國和伊朗衝突的努力中取得進展，美國財政部長貝森特亦稱，可能週二或週三達成恢復荷姆茲海峽通航協議，激發樂觀情緒，推升歐元兌美元至 1.1534 高點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於 1.1540-60，支撐於 1.1460-80。
◆GBP/USD
週二市場等待美國和伊朗和平談判的消息，同時警惕日本與美國實施進一步干預，導致英鎊兌美元徘徊於 1.3415 低點。隨著市場關注週五美國就業報告，以調整對 FED 加息的預期，但美國國務卿魯比奧稱，荷姆茲海峽通航相關磋商已取得進展，激勵英鎊兌美元回升至 1.3455 高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於 1.3450-70，支撐於 1.3370-90。

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 日元走弱但仍遠高於干預前低點
items.title_en: Dollar Holds Steady as Yen Weakens but Remains Above 40-Year Low
paras: 美元周二 (4 日) 變動不大，外匯市場焦點仍集中在日元走勢。雖然日元兌美元回落，但仍明顯高於上周美日聯手干預匯市前所觸及的 40 年低點。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 幾乎持平，報 99.88。
美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 本周稍早證實，美國已與日本聯手進場買進日元，這是 2011 年以來雙方首次聯合干預匯市，也是美國自 1998 年以來首度直接出手支持日元匯價。
貝森特周二接受 CNBC 採訪時表示，美方之所以協助日本，是因為日元持續貶值可能對亞洲金融市場帶來不穩定影響。
他表示，「考量到貿易流量、日本經濟規模及其對全球儲蓄市場的重要性，維持日元穩定非常重要。日本政府了解這點，我們也很榮幸能與日本攜手推動相關政策，協助穩定區域市場。」
在此次干預前，日元兌美元一度跌至 164 日元，創下 40 年新低。日元走弱將對高度依賴進口的日本經濟帶來壓力。日本也是全球持有美國公債最多的海外國家，因此日元匯率波動一直受到市場高度關注。
AJ Bell 投資總監 Russ Mould 表示，「這十年來日元貶值幅度之大，以至於華府與東京都不得不聯手支撐匯價。不過，美國的參與恐怕並非完全無私。相較於日本首相高市早苗 (Sanae Takaichi) 所面臨的債務與通膨問題，美國財長貝森特更擔心的是，日本若出售龐大的美國公債部位，可能對市場造成衝擊。」
華爾街策略師指出，美國明確表示願意動用資源協助干預，意味著市場過去認為單一央行受限於外匯存底的「儲備上限」限制已大幅降低。
為降低市場干預可能對金融市場造成的衝擊，美日兩國財政部也表示，未來將利用聯準會的外國與國際貨幣當局附買回機制 (Foreign and International Monetary Authorities, FIMA Repo Facility)，在後續市場操作中提供流動性支持。
Brown Brothers Harriman 市場策略主管 Elias Haddad 表示，「任何反彈都可能只是短暫的，並成為逢高賣出美元兌日元的機會。美日聯手干預，加上官員明確表示必要時將再次出手，大幅提高市場與官方對作的成本，也使美元兌日元的上行空間受到更明顯限制。」
美元兌日元上漲 0.4%，至 157.76。
美元持平 市場聚焦就業數據
在上周受到聯準會利率前景不明，以及美日聯手干預日元等因素影響而大幅下跌後，美元指數本周大致維持區間整理。
市場本周將持續關注美國勞動市場數據，以尋找聯準會 (Fed) 未來利率政策方向的新線索。
美國勞工統計局周二公布，6 月 JOLTS 職缺數為 735.9 萬個，低於市場預估的 745.4 萬個。5 月職缺數也由原先公布的 759.4 萬個下修至 753.7 萬個，而 4 月職缺數曾升至 758.5 萬個，創下 2024 年 5 月以來新高。
雖然 6 月職缺數低於市場預期，但整體報告仍顯示，美國就業市場依舊保持穩健。
這份數據也支持聯準會近期將政策重心重新放在抑制通膨。由於充分就業目標目前已大致達成，因此聯準會目前更專注於通膨任務。
另一方面，中東衝突導致油價波動，也改變了市場對通膨的預期，並使聯準會官員對未來貨幣政策方向出現分歧。
這周勞動市場數據的重頭戲，將是周五公布的 7 月非農就業報告。
其他主要貨幣方面，歐元兌美元上漲 0.2%，至 1 歐元兌 1.1531 美元。
英鎊兌美元也上漲 0.2%，至 1 英鎊兌 1.3450 美元。
中東局勢持續受到關注。國際油價周二連續第二個交易日下跌，有助於抑制通膨壓力。
貝森特接受 CNBC 訪問時表示，他相信美國與伊朗正接近達成協議，「我們有機會在今天或明天達成協議，重新開放荷姆茲海峽 (Strait of Hormuz)，讓這場衝突逐步回到較為正常的狀態。」
此外，卡達表示，促成伊朗衝突外交解決方案的努力仍在持續，目前談判重點包括局勢降溫，以及重新開放荷姆茲海峽。
根據媒體報導，作為美國與伊朗之間的重要區域調解者，卡達透露，協議草案文字已經完成，並正在各談判方之間傳閱。
雖然目前各方尚未同意展開直接談判，但卡達表示，短期內達成一項初步協議仍是目前最主要目標。

paras_en: The dollar was relatively unchanged on Tuesday, with the foreign exchange market's focus still on the yen's trajectory. Although the yen fell against the dollar, it remained significantly higher than the 40-year low it touched before the US-Japan intervention last week.
At the New York close, the dollar index, which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, was almost unchanged at 99.88.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirmed earlier this week that the US had intervened in the foreign exchange market with Japan, a move that marked the first joint intervention since 2011 and the first direct US support for the yen since 1998.
Bessent told CNBC on Tuesday that the US was helping Japan because a continued decline in the yen could have destabilizing effects on Asian financial markets.

He said, "Given the importance of trade flows, Japan's economic size, and its importance to global savings markets, maintaining a stable yen is crucial. The Japanese government understands this, and we're honored to be working with them to implement policies that help stabilize the region's markets."

Before the intervention, the yen had fallen to 164 yen per dollar, a 40-year low. A weaker yen would put pressure on Japan's economy, which relies heavily on imports. Japan is also the largest foreign holder of US debt, making the yen's exchange rate highly watched by the market.

Russ Mould, investment director at AJ Bell, said, "The scale of the yen's decline over the past decade has been so great that Washington and Tokyo have had to join forces to support the currency. However, the US involvement may not be entirely altruistic. Compared to Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's debt and inflation problems, US Treasury Secretary Bessent is more concerned about the potential impact of Japan selling its large US Treasury holdings on the market."

Wall Street strategists noted that the US has made it clear that it is willing to use its resources to intervene, implying that the market's previous assumption that a single central bank was limited by its foreign exchange reserves "reserve constraint" has been significantly reduced.

To minimize the impact of the intervention on financial markets, the US and Japanese finance ministries said they would use the Federal Reserve's Foreign and International Monetary Authorities (FIMA) Repo Facility to provide liquidity support in future market operations.

Elias Haddad, market strategy head at Brown Brothers Harriman, said, "Any rebound could be short-lived and become an opportunity to sell the dollar-yen pair. The joint US-Japan intervention, combined with officials' statements that they would intervene again if necessary, has significantly increased the cost of trading and has limited the dollar-yen pair's upside space."
The dollar-yen pair rose 0.4% to 157.76.
The dollar held steady as the market focused on US employment data.

After a sharp decline last week due to uncertainty over the Federal Reserve's interest rate outlook and the US-Japan intervention in the yen, the dollar index has maintained a trading range this week.
The market will continue to focus on US labor market data to find new clues about the Federal Reserve's future interest rate policy direction.
The US Bureau of Labor Statistics reported on Tuesday that the June JOLTS job openings number was 7.359 million, lower than the market's estimate of 7.454 million.
The May job openings number was also revised downward to 7.537 million from the previously reported 7.594 million, while the April job openings number had risen to 7.585 million, a new high for 2024.
Although the June job openings number was lower than expected, the overall report showed that the US labor market remains stable.
This data also supports the Federal Reserve's recent shift in policy focus to inflation suppression, as the full employment target has been largely achieved.
On the other hand, the Middle East conflict has changed market expectations for inflation, and Federal Reserve officials have differing views on future monetary policy direction.
The highlight of this week's labor market data will be the release of the July non-farm employment report on Friday.
Other major currencies, the euro rose 0.2% against the dollar to 1.1531 euros per dollar, and the pound rose 0.2% against the dollar to 1.3450 pounds per dollar.
The Middle East situation remains a concern, with international oil prices falling for the second consecutive trading day, helping to ease inflationary pressures.

Bessent told CNBC that he believes the US and Iran are close to reaching an agreement, "We have a chance to reach an agreement today or tomorrow, reopen the Strait of Hormuz, and bring this conflict back to a more normal state."
Qatar also said that efforts to promote a diplomatic solution to the Iran conflict are ongoing, with a focus on de-escalating tensions and reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
According to media reports, as a key mediator in the US-Iran conflict, Qatar revealed that the draft agreement text has been completed and is being circulated among the negotiating parties.
Although the parties have not yet agreed to hold direct talks, Qatar said that reaching a preliminary agreement in the short term remains the main goal.
